data.title: Executive Assistant
data.description:
TL;DR: As our first Executive Assistant, you'll support Conduct's founders by protecting their time, keeping priorities moving and making the company feel sharper in how it runs day to day. It's a high-trust role, close to every big decision, at a company running faster than ever.

WHY CONDUCT

We believe the world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the decade-old systems they run on. Today they don't.

Every process change, every new product line runs into software systems layered with decades of custom code and complexity no human mind can fully comprehend. New requirements take months to ship, system migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed and ambition. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You'll work side by side with our three founders as they tackle one of the most complex problems of our generation. Their time is one of the most valuable things we have, and you'll help to decide how it gets spent. One day that means getting a CEO to a customer in Germany. The next, it's prepping a board meeting or landing a candidate we've been chasing for months. Plans often change hourly and you'll help keep everything on track. You'll be our first EA, so you'll set the standard for how we support the founders. As we grow, the team around you might too, and you'll help shape how it works. Few roles give you this view of how a generational company gets built, and as we scale, your scope grows with us.

In practice:

  • Help run packed founder calendars and decide what they spend their time on

  • Set up the meetings that move Conduct forward, with enterprise customers, investors and partners, and make sure everyone walks in prepared and walks out with next steps

  • Plan global founder travel and fix it fast when things don’t go to plan

  • Live in founder inboxes and threads, prioritising by what matters most to the business, handling what you can and flagging what you can’t

  • Write on the founders' behalf to customers, investors and partners, and get every detail right

  • Keep board and investor meetings running smoothly, from scheduling to follow-ups

  • Help candidates have a great first experience of Conduct

  • Spot what's slowing the team down and build the fix

WHO WE HIRE

You're the person everyone goes to when something needs to get done properly. You're sharp, calm under pressure and good with people, and you'd rather be in the room where decisions happen than watching from the outside. You might already be an EA, or you might be in a role where you've quietly been doing the job of one.

In practice that tends to look like:

  • You've supported founders, CEOs, or senior execs in a high-pressure, high-excellence environment, ideally a fast-scaling startup, and you know how to keep up

  • You thrive when things are messy and moving fast, and you bring structure without waiting to be asked

  • You're smart and proactive, and you see what's needed before anyone asks

  • You're happy to push back, even with a founder, when something doesn't need to happen

  • You communicate clearly and confidently, in writing and in person, whether it's an investor, a customer or a new hire

  • You bring maturity and sound judgement to confidential matters

  • When something doesn't work, you fix it or automate it, and you'll happily pick up work that's nowhere near your job description

  • You have a zero-error mindset: anything with your name or a founder's on it is right first time, even on the busiest days

  • Speaking German is a plus

data.title: Talent Partner
data.description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The role:

Multiverse’s mission is to equip the workforce to win in the AI era. Joining us means being part of a talented team, tackling the challenges of being in a scaling organisation solving complex problems, whilst contributing to our company and product growth. As a team, we always prioritise quality - you’ll hold the hiring bar whilst keeping pipeline moving when there’s commercial pressure to move fast.

As a Talent Partner, you’ll be growing your experience as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, and own end-to-end recruitment for the roles you’re responsible for. You’ll show up prepared with market knowledge, using it to set realistic expectations on timelines, candidate availability and what the market will and won’t accept, and adjusting your approach when conditions change. You’ll use pipeline data to spot where a process is breaking down and fix it. You use AI to power your productivity, and focus your time on what AI can’t do: building strong stakeholder relationships, giving candidates an exceptional experience and building connections.

Teams you’ll support: Operations - this is our learner-facing org who work day-in-day-out to give our apprentices a great learning experience and provide measurable impact to our customers; and G&A - our core business partnering teams across People and Talent, Finance, Legal, CEO Office and Comms.

If you have experience as a recruiter or Talent Partner, ideally somewhere with a high talent bar, and are genuinely excited about being at the forefront of a fast-evolving recruiting role, we’d love for you to apply.

What you’ll do:

  • Run recruiting for your roles end-to-end: attraction and sourcing, qualifying and hiring top talent for Multiverse. We have a high hiring bar, and you’ll partner closely with managers to assess the market, calibrate regularly, build rigour into our assessment and make pivots based on data.

  • Partner with hiring managers to expertly qualify requirements, challenge assumptions using market data and past hiring experience, and build a shared understanding of what good looks like.

  • Design structured interview and assessment processes for the roles you own.

  • Be an exceptional operator, running processes that focus on the very highest quality of hire as we scale, and make the most of your tech stack to do so. We invest in great tools (Ashby, Claude, Gemini, Juicebox, Brighthire, LinkedIn) to support you. You’ll source through these platforms and build your own network and referrals.

  • Manage candidate relationships end-to-end: anticipating candidates’ needs and questions, tailoring your communication to their profile and stage in the pipeline, building buy-in and providing high quality, timely feedback. You’ll own candidate experience and maintain strong NPS, and build talent pools from silver medallists.

  • Analyse pipeline data to identify where a hiring process is breaking down, and use those insights to adjust your sourcing or process.

  • Partner with your colleagues across the People and Talent team to ensure we’re collectively driving the right talent outcomes for Multiverse.

We value competence more than years of experience, but you’ll most likely have the following to be successful:

What you’ll bring:

  • You embody our Operating Principles in how you work.

  • Proven experience in a recruiting or Talent Partner role, supporting multiple hiring managers, ideally in a scaling, highly agile business environment.

  • You can credibly partner with managers, and are confident using market knowledge to advise constructively.

  • You can evaluate candidates effectively, and stay regularly calibrated with your hiring team. You can point to where you’ve designed or improved structured assessment and coached managers.

  • You build strong candidate relationships, understanding skills, motivations and decision criteria, and handle feedback conversations well.

  • You’re comfortable with data, and use it alongside qualitative feedback to spot problems and change course.

  • You are highly motivated and autonomous, but curious to learn and ask questions where you don’t know.

  • You are building AI into your everyday workflows, and are rigorous in your approach to data hygiene to ensure good tools are built on even better data, and verify the outputs.

Why this role may not be for you

  • You don’t want to run things end-to-end. You’ll own your hires and how to deliver them here.

  • You struggle with ambiguity; our business and skills requirements are evolving fast and we need to navigate through that with our hiring managers.

  • You don’t get your energy speaking to candidates. We are building an AI-first team with the explicit intention of spending more time where it matters, in the market, speaking with top talent.

Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

  • Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

Providing false information is an offence and could result in the application being rejected or summary dismissal if the applicant has been selected, and possible referral to the police and the DBS.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

Why this role exists

Multiverse builds AI products for the future of work, and we want our own People team to run on the same principles we sell to customers. This role is about building an AI-native People function from the ground up, with someone who thinks in systems: workflows, guardrails, tasks and constraints, rather than one-off fixes. We care more about how you learn and build than how many years you've clocked up. If you've built something you can show us, whether that's a tool, a process, or a system that scaled, bring it. That's a bigger part of the interview than a standard work history.

What you'll actually do

A People Product Lead bridges People strategy with hands-on technical product management. You will build scalable foundations for internal operations such as core HR systems, automation, access, and data flows supporting ~1000 employees across the lifecycle

  • Define the long-term vision, strategy, and quarterly roadmap for internal People Ops technology and platforms including success measures for the domain.

  • Build scalable foundations across People systems that support the employee lifecycle, from core People platforms to integrations, data flows, identity and automation.

  • Make high-quality trade-offs across build, buy and integrate decisions, balancing user experience, scalability, reliability, security and compliance.

  • Lead through influence by aligning senior stakeholders across People, Engineering, Security, Compliance, Legal, Analytics and Operations.

  • Improve productivity and reduce friction for Multiverse employees by simplifying processes and creating intuitive, reliable technology experiences.

  • Drive measurable impact by defining KPIs, learning from delivery and continuously improving how the domain operates.

You will be successful if…

  • You have 5+ years working in HR, in technology, analytics, or operations

  • You think in systems: workflows, guardrails, constraints, and how the parts fit together

  • You have a strong track record of learning fast and applying it

  • You've built something real you can walk us through: a tool, a process, or a system you scaled

This role won’t work for you if…

  • You're uncomfortable working with technology and automation

  • You prefer high-touch, service-led processes over product-led ways of working

Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!

The Leadership & Culture Development Lead owns how Neko's leaders are developed and how the leadership bar shows up in practice, plus which culture products get built and how they deploy across markets.

Leadership development

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Case Management
data.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Role overview

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help build and evolve our new Common case-management system, which powers support-case handling across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.

You will own significant end-to-end initiatives across our backend services: case lifecycle, routing and assignment, queue management, case evidence and history, and migration from legacy systems. This is a hands-on role for someone who can turn ambiguous customer and operational problems into durable technical solutions, coordinate other engineers, and set the standard for reliability and craftsmanship on the team.

What you'll do

  • Lead one or more project-level Case Management initiatives, on your own or by guiding a group of engineers, from discovery and design through rollout, measurement, and operational ownership.
  • Design and build scalable backend services and APIs for case creation, routing, assignment, transfers, audit history, notes, attachments, and queue-management workflows.
  • Help deliver feature parity with legacy platforms while safely migrating traffic across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.
  • Make and own most technical decisions within your scope. Write project-level design documents covering how sub-features interact, identify dependencies and risks, and break work into parallelizable delivery plans.
  • Scope ambiguous customer and operational problems, weigh long-term against short-term trade-offs, and design durable solutions.
  • Partner with Product, Operations, Support, Data, and other engineering teams to define the right problems. Shape the team roadmap through prototypes, data analysis, project proposals, and backlog prioritization.
  • Run the coordination a project needs, such as status updates and dependency tracking, and escalate early to keep delivery on time.
  • Enforce team-wide quality objectives: lead design reviews, calibrate quality metrics, and improve logging, monitoring, alerting, and escalation policies.
  • Serve as first responder or incident commander, model good incident practice, and turn what you learn into playbooks and backlog work.
  • Introduce and guide AI best practices for the team, including evals, data privacy, and review of AI-generated code, and take part in AI-powered projects when they are central to the product.
  • Design reusable, self-serviceable solutions, and consider cost efficiency, including compute and AI costs, in key designs.
  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, design guidance, tech talks, and constructive feedback. Interview candidates, join sell calls, and take part in hiring events when the team needs them.

Must-have qualifications

  • Strong backend engineering experience, including designing and operating backend services, APIs, asynchronous workflows, and data models at meaningful scale.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern backend language, and a record of writing exemplary code for the core functionality of key components.
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex, customer-facing or operations-critical projects from technical design through production rollout.
  • Experience breaking projects into parallelizable work, identifying dependencies and risks, and giving accurate estimates for yourself and others.
  • Hands-on experience using AI development tools to improve productivity, while validating generated output for correctness, security, privacy, maintainability, and reliability.
  • Strong product judgment: the ability to turn ambiguous workflows and user needs into simple, maintainable technical solutions.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across functions, bring the right stakeholders into decisions at the right time, and explain trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong engineering craft: testing, code review, observability, incident response, security, and operational readiness, with experience designing for reliability.
  • Comfort working on systems with high correctness and auditability requirements, including traceability of decisions and changes.
  • A mentoring mindset and a record of raising team-wide engineering standards.

Nice-to-have qualifications

  • Go experience.
  • Experience with migration from legacy systems, gradual rollouts, traffic shadowing, and feature-parity programs.
  • Experience supporting internal tools or operational user interfaces from the backend side.
  • Experience with high-volume, multi-region, or multi-tenant systems.
  • Experience as an incident commander or in running an on-call rotation.
  • Experience building AI-powered features, including evaluation of model output.

What success looks like

  • Delivers a major Case Management initiative with clear technical ownership, predictable execution, and measurable customer or business impact.
  • Improves the reliability, maintainability, and cost efficiency of the Common system while enabling safe migration from legacy case-management systems.
  • Helps move support traffic onto the Common system without reducing case-resolution quality.
  • Builds solutions that other engineers and operators can confidently reuse and operate.
  • Acts as a technical leader within the team: unblocks peers and partner teams, improves engineering decisions, influences the roadmap, and strengthens cross-functional execution.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

data.description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What you'll do

This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands.

At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area.

In this role, you will:

  • Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results.

  • Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land.

  • Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments.

  • Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current.

  • Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own.

  • Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases.

  • Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched.

  • Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure.

  • Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams.

  • Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice.

  • Some of the technical questions in this area are still open. You will help answer them.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • Bachelors degree in STEM discipline and 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production ownership of services, pipelines, or SDKs.

  • 2+ years shipping LLM-backed features to real users, in systems that carried error budgets, on-call rotations, and customers who noticed regressions.

  • Direct experience or deep understanding of designing evaluations for non-deterministic systems. You can describe a dataset you built and the failure it caught.

  • Data engineering depth: SQL, at least one distributed processing framework, and experience with pipelines where a wrong record mattered more than a slow one.

  • Fluency with tool calling and agent orchestration, including the failure modes: stale context, hallucinated arguments, silent partial success, unbounded loops.

  • Working knowledge of more than one agent harness, and opinions about where each of them is weak.

  • Strong Python or TypeScript, and comfort reading code in whatever language the caller happens to be written in.

  • Experience diagnosing latency in a distributed request path.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to ship something narrow that works while the general solution is still unclear.

  • Clear written communication. Mapbox is distributed across time zones and we make most decisions in documents and Slack.

Nice to have traits for this role

  • Geospatial data experience: routing, geocoding, POI or address data, OpenStreetMap, or conflation of overlapping sources.

  • Public API or SDK design experience, particularly for developers you never talk to.

  • Experience building against MCP or similar tool transports.

  • Experience running evals in CI, with a commercial harness or one you built.

  • Automotive, in-vehicle infotainment, CarPlay, or Android Auto experience.

  • Voice pipeline experience: streaming ASR, TTS, barge-in, endpointing, wake word.

  • Work under constrained compute, offline, or intermittent connectivity.

  • Experience operating a product through its first external integrations, where the customer finds the gaps before you do.

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

 

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Non-US Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application.

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

data.title: Head of Legal
data.description:
Remote | United Kingdom | Crypto & Payments | FCA Authorisation | Employment or B2B

Our client is an established, profitable fintech operating at the intersection of crypto and traditional payments. It runs a consumer on/off-ramp platform and a fast-growing B2B infrastructure business: APIs and white-label solutions that let exchanges, neobanks, PSPs, wallets and other platforms embed regulated crypto and fiat services. The company is authorised under MiCA and PSD2 in the EU and is now building its regulatory presence in the UK. The culture is owner-led, high-ownership and low-bureaucracy: decisions are made quickly and close to the founders.

About the role

This is a senior, hands-on legal role with a single, clear mandate: own the company’s UK regulatory build. You will report directly to the CEO and be the most senior legal voice in the business on UK matters.

The UK’s new cryptoasset regime takes effect in October 2027. From that date, regulated cryptoasset activity in the UK requires FCA authorisation. You will own a first-wave authorisation under this new regime end to end, alongside a UK e-money application. For a regulatory lawyer, this is a career-defining piece of work, and the window to start it is narrow.

The role has no direct reports at hire. You will work closely with the company’s EU legal function. This is a deliberately focused UK mandate, not a group legal role.

What you will own

  • FCA cryptoasset authorisation: perimeter analysis of B2C and B2B activities against the new regime, application strategy, drafting, regulatory business plan input, RFI handling and dialogue through to decision.

  • UK EMI application: ownership on the same basis, including sequencing between the two applications.

  • FCA relationship: acting as the senior in-house legal counterpart to the regulator.

  • UK conduct perimeter: the cryptoasset financial promotions regime, Consumer Duty, the UK Travel Rule, and safeguarding and prudential requirements.

  • Post-authorisation readiness: governance, senior manager and certification considerations, reporting and disclosures.

  • External counsel: briefing, directing and quality-controlling UK external counsel, and managing that spend.

  • International expansion: legal lead on additional licence applications in other jurisdictions, and advice where the UK and EU regulatory perimeters meet.

  • Commercial legal: drafting and negotiating English-law B2B agreements. This includes MSAs, API and white-label terms, referral and agent agreements, and banking, payment and card scheme counterparty agreements.

  • UK consumer-facing legal: consumer terms, financial promotions review and UK-specific disclosures.

  • UK employment: UK employment law and contractor arrangements, in partnership with HR.

What we are looking for

  • Qualified solicitor or barrister in England & Wales, typically with 8+ years PQE.

  • Hands-on UK financial services regulatory experience, including at least one FCA authorisation or variation of permission that you personally owned or materially led, from perimeter analysis to decision.

  • Direct, personal interaction with the FCA: correspondence, meetings and representation that you led yourself.

  • Crypto or digital-asset legal experience at licensed or established firms, such as registered or authorised exchanges, regulated on/off-ramps, licensed custodians or infrastructure providers.

  • Cryptoasset, e-money or payments perimeter experience. Engagement with the 2025–26 FCA cryptoasset consultations is highly relevant.

  • Ability to draft and negotiate English-law B2B fintech agreements independently.

  • A track record of owning regulatory outcomes, not only advising on them. Law-firm backgrounds are welcome where this is evident.

  • Ability to take a clear position under pressure from senior stakeholders and counterparties, and to translate legal risk into business options with a recommendation.

  • Comfort operating as a remote senior with no legal support structure beneath you, working with a leadership team based outside the UK.

  • Practical use of AI tools in legal drafting, research or review.

  • Fluent legal English to regulator-facing standard.

  • Existing right to work in the UK, and the ability to attend regulator meetings in London as required.

Team management experience is not required. We welcome strong senior counsel ready to step into a Head of Legal role.

Nice to have

  • Previous Head of Legal, GC or senior counsel role at a UK-authorised EMI, PI or FCA-registered cryptoasset firm.

  • Experience of a firm moving from AML registration to full FSMA authorisation.

  • Involvement in industry working groups or trade association engagement on the new UK crypto regime.

  • SM&CR experience.

  • Knowledge of UK safeguarding and prudential requirements for e-money and payments.

  • Crown Dependency (Jersey, Guernsey, Isle of Man) or Australian regulatory exposure.

  • Card scheme legal experience, such as Visa/Mastercard rules and principal membership.

  • Experience building a legal or regulatory function in a jurisdiction from scratch.

What’s on offer

  • A direct reporting line to the CEO and ownership of the company’s UK market entry.

  • A defining role in a first-wave authorisation under the UK’s new cryptoasset regime.

  • A remote setup in the UK, with a flat structure and fast decisions.

  • An employment or B2B contract, with a performance bonus linked to UK authorisation milestones.

  • A fast, transparent hiring process, typically completed within four weeks.

data.title: Product Designer
data.description:
Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world.

Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.

Dave is an inspector. Today he's climbing through one of Europe's biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he'll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.

We're building the best AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we're building the world's largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.

It's a $2T market and we're just getting started, with ambitions. We work with 6 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX.

We've assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Goldman Sachs, Flexport and Amazon.

Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures, the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with 100+ unicorns backed to date.

About the role

We're hiring our first Product Designer.

Every engineer at Scope is a product engineer: they talk to users, decide what to build and ship it themselves. You'll work the same way, with design as your edge, and help the engineers around you to build a better product. That covers the whole experience, not just the surface: which problem we solve, how the flow works, what happens when things go wrong, and how it all looks. You'll work closely with the engineers, with Ish our Product Manager, and with Jakob the CTO.

We work in person five days a week from our office in Farringdon.

What you'll work on

Some examples of surfaces in our product that will need your help:

  • Our mobile app gets used inside tanks and on top of pressure vessels. People wear thick gloves, there's usually no signal, and one hand is often holding on to something. Most of what makes a normal app pleasant doesn't apply there, so a big part of the job is figuring out what does.

  • Then there's the report. How AI and the inspector will work together to produce 40 page reports and review them is something nobody has designed well yet.

  • Inspectors but also decision makers should be able to ask things like "Which tanks were over the corrosion limit last year?". Sometimes the right interface will be a chat but often it isn't.

What you'll do

  • Go on site with inspectors and test your designs there, gloves and all.

  • Own the design of every launch, down to the empty states.

  • Prototype fast, in code when it helps.

  • Work next to engineers while they build, so the details come out right.

  • Decide with Ish and Jakob which problems are worth solving.

  • Build the design system that lets engineers ship great work without waiting on you.

Who you are

  • Minimum 3 years designing products that were shipped.

  • A portfolio that shows the messy middle, not just the final screens.

  • You sweat the mobile details: touch targets, offline, errors.

  • You have opinions on where AI helps and where it gets in the way.

  • You'd happily put on a hard hat to understand a problem.

  • Bonus if you've designed for industrial or field work, or prototype in code.

Interview process

  • Intro call.

  • Portfolio deep dive with Ish and an engineer: one project, including what went wrong.

  • Interview with a cofounder: Jonny (CEO) or Jakob (CTO and CPO).

  • Onsite: a real Scope design problem, worked on with the team, then a short presentation.

  • Offer!

What we offer

  • £70k to £100k base + significant equity, so you have a stake in what you are building

  • Full visa sponsorship, giving us access to global talent and an international, diverse team

  • Tools to do your job, including a brand new MacBook and Scope merch

  • Generous above-market annual leave allowance

  • Bupa private medical (0 excess, pre-existing conditions covered) + Bupa dental

  • Employee pension through NEST

  • Flexible parental leave (including adoption leave)

  • Healthy meal-prep lunch and dinners, a fully stocked fridge, and team lunches on Fridays

  • Regular events including off-sites

We value diverse perspectives. If you don't match every point above but this is the kind of problem you want to work on, we strongly encourage you to apply.

data.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

As a Research Engineer, GPU performance, you will sit at the heart of that spectrum: your low-level work directly determines how fast our frontier models can be trained and served. Working hand-in-hand with Research Scientists, you'll make every GPU count.

Mistral AI is hiring an expert in pushing large language model's GPU utilization and performance to their limits.. In this role, you will own the performance of our models end-to-end: writing the low-level code that extracts the maximum capacity from high-end hardware, and rethinking model architectures so they run efficiently at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Develop low-level code that takes full advantage of high-end GPUs and maxes out their capacity — from custom kernels to memory-layout and communication optimisations.

  • Rethink parts of the generative model architecture to make them more suitable for efficient inference, in collaboration with Research Scientists.

  • Integrate low-level efficient code into a high-level MLOps framework, so that optimisations benefit every training run and deployment rather than a single experiment.

  • Profile, benchmark and squeeze performance out of large-scale training and inference on thousands of GPUs.

  • Model LLM execution on various GPUs with high fidelity to assess hardware usage and build serving performance estimates.

What We're Looking For

  • High technical competence for writing custom low-level kernels and pushing GPUs to their limits.

  • High expertise in the distributed computation infrastructure of current-generation GPU clusters.

  • Overall understanding of the field of generative AI; knowledge of, or interest in, fine-tuning and using language models for applications.

  • Strong software-design instincts: testing, code review, CI/CD.

  • Self-starter, low-ego, collaborative.

What We Offer

About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Au sein de l'équipe technique, vous concevez en CAO les pièces et sous-ensembles mécaniques de nos produits, dans nos drones et leurs équipements embarqués. Votre quotidien est la modélisation sous Fusion 360 et Solidworks : mécanismes et pièces imprimés en 3D, intégration des composants électroniques, assemblages complets.

Vous faites évoluer rapidement les designs à partir des impressions et des essais, et vous produisez les plans, nomenclatures et documents de montage des versions validées.

Missions principales

Conception CAO (cœur de métier : 70 %)

  • Concevoir et modéliser sous Fusion 360 et Solidworks des pièces et sous-ensembles : structures, carters, supports, fixations, interfaces

  • Concevoir des mécanismes imprimés en 3D : charnières, verrouillages, clips, pièces mobiles

  • Intégrer les composants électroniques dans la CAO : implantation des cartes, moteurs, ESC, batteries et capteurs, passage des câbles, refroidissement, accessibilité pour la maintenance

  • Appliquer les règles de conception FDM et autres procédés : orientation, épaisseurs, jeux et tolérances d'assemblage, inserts, limitation des supports

  • Structurer les assemblages (paramétrage, composants réutilisables) pour faciliter les évolutions

  • Assurer la gestion des versions des fichiers CAO

  • Réaliser des conceptions paramétriques et modifiables

Prototypage rapide (15 %)

  • Enchaîner des cycles courts conception → impression 3D → test → correction

  • Préparer les impressions sous OrcaSlicer et assembler les prototypes

  • Faire évoluer les designs à partir des retours d'impression et d'essais

data.title: Stagiaire Conception CAO & protoypage mécatronique
data.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Type de contrat : stage de 6 mois

Objet du poste

Au sein de l'équipe technique, vous participez à la conception et à la réalisation de nos prototypes, principalement des drones et leurs équipements embarqués. Votre mission est majoritairement axée sur la conception mécanique en CAO, avec une fabrication des pièces essentiellement en impression 3D. Ponctuellement, vous intervenez sur l'intégration et le dimensionnement de l'électronique embarquée afin de valider les prototypes de bout en bout, de la modélisation aux premiers essais. Vous contribuez ensuite à la mise en production des produits validés (DFM, optimisations, gammes de montage, schémas de câblage).

Missions principales

Conception CAO (cœur de mission : 55%)

  • Concevoir et modéliser sous Fusion 360 des pièces et sous-ensembles mécaniques : structures, carters, supports, fixations, interfaces de charges utiles, …

  • Intégrer dès la conception les contraintes de la fabrication additive FDM : orientation, épaisseurs, jeux et tolérances d'assemblage, inserts, limitation des supports

  • Faire évoluer rapidement les designs à partir des retours d'impression et d'essais (cycles d'itération courts)

  • Réaliser les assemblages, et assurer la gestion des versions des fichiers CAO

Prototypage rapide (5%)

Enchaîner des cycles courts conception → impression 3D → test → correction pour valider rapidement les choix techniques

  • Analyser les résultats d'essais et les retours terrain afin d'orienter les itérations suivantes

  • Préparer les impressions sous OrcaSlicer et assembler les prototypes dans un objectif d’amélioration continue

Industrialisation et mise en production (30%)

  • Faire évoluer les prototypes validés vers une version industrialisable en appliquant les principes DFM / DFA (conception pour la fabrication et l'assemblage)

  • Optimiser les pièces et sous-ensembles : masse, coût, nombre de pièces, temps de fabrication, choix des procédés et matériaux de série

  • Participer à la rédaction les gammes de montage et les instructions d'assemblage

  • Réaliser les schémas de câblage et la documentation électrique associée

  • Constituer le dossier de définition du produit : plans, nomenclatures, tolérances

Intégration et dimensionnement électronique (5%)

  • Participer au choix et au dimensionnement des composants embarqués (motorisation, ESC, batteries, contrôleur de vol, capteurs, câblage) selon les contraintes du prototype : masse, encombrement, consommation, thermique

  • Prévoir dans la CAO l'implantation des cartes et composants, le passage des câbles, le refroidissement et l'accessibilité pour la maintenance

  • Assembler, câbler et réaliser les premiers tests d'intégration pour valider le fonctionnement des prototypes

  • Configurer et paramétrer les systèmes via Mission Planner (calibrations, paramètres, check avant vols)

Essais et documentation (5%)

  • Participer aux essais de validation : tests au banc, tests au sol et, le cas échéant, essais en vol encadrés

  • Documenter les conceptions, les choix techniques et les résultats d'essais

  • Présenter régulièrement l'avancement de ses travaux à l'équipe technique

Profil recherché

Formation

  • Étudiant(e) de niveau Bac+3 à Bac+5 (école d'ingénieurs, licence professionnelle, master) en conception mécanique, génie mécanique, mécatronique ou équivalent

  • Stage (idéalement de fin d'études)

Compétences techniques

  • Très bonne maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO 3D, idéalement Autodesk Fusion

  • Connaissance des règles de conception pour l'impression 3D FDM ; la pratique d'OrcaSlicer (ou d'un autre slicer) est appréciée

  • Notions de résistance des matériaux, de tolérancement et de choix des matériaux (PLA, PETG, ASA, nylon, composites chargés)

  • Bases en électronique embarquée : lecture de schémas, alimentation et puissance, dimensionnement de composants, soudure et câblage

Atouts

  • Connaissance du monde des drones (multirotors, voilure fixe, ArduPilot / PX4) est un gros plus

  • Notions d'aérodynamique (portance, traînée, profils, hélices) est un plus

  • Profil mécatronique, capable de faire le lien entre mécanique, électronique et logiciel

  • Projets personnels ou associatifs en drone, robotique ou impression 3D

  • Un intérêt pour les environnements aéronautique, spatial ou défense est apprécié

Qualités personnelles

  • Curiosité et goût pour le prototypage et le travail « hands-on »

  • Rigueur et sens du détail, indispensables dans un contexte défense où la fiabilité des pièces est critique

  • Autonomie, force de proposition et capacité à travailler en équipe

About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

You'll be part of our Mirakl Labs Financial Services squad, based in Paris. The team is structured as a cross-functional Squad composed of a Senior Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, Software Engineers  and a QA engineer. You'll be mentored by Wael Osmani, Software Engineer. You'll join a team that builds and ships the core product features powering some of the world's most ambitious marketplace platforms, with a particular focus on financial services capabilities.


2. Your Impact

  • Contribute to the development and evolution of a production application, primarily on the frontend — from UI implementation to user experience improvements

Experience:
  • Currently pursuing a Master's degree (M1 or M2) in software engineering, computer science, or a related field, and looking for a 6-month internship

  • Solid understanding of frontend development and object-oriented programming principles
Skills:

  • Curiosity for clean code, software quality, and working on production-grade applications

4. Tech Stack

  • Back-end: Java 21, Spring Boot
  • Front-end: ReactJS
  • Data & Messaging: Kafka, ElasticSearch, PostgreSQL
  • Tooling & Practices: CI/CD, Git, Docker, Monitoring


5. Languages

  • French: Fluent
  • English: Professional proficiency (written and spoken)

 

Compensation, Perks & Benefits

  • Pay Range: €1,200 – €1,400 per month

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

  1. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter, then an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application.
  2. Recruiter interview (30 min) — conversation about your background, motivations, and an introduction to Mirakl
  3. Hiring Manager interview (45 min) — technical discussion covering Java and web development fundamentals, including practical exercises
  4. STAR interview (1h) — exchange with one or two team members exploring Mirakl's values and culture

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. data.title: Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights
data.description:
We are growing! We are currently looking to hire a Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights.  

About CXG:

Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience company uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide.

The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation.

We are passionate about delivering impact.

Our clients include the world's most admired luxury houses, and our solutions combine research, technology, and human expertise to elevate every customer interaction.

We are looking for a thought leadership expert with the editorial vision to spot what matters next, the conviction to shape CXG's point of view, and the writing talent to make it influential across luxury retail, beauty and cosmetics, watches and jewellery, automotive, and hospitality.

Context and role

Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you will lead CXG's Thought Leadership and Market Intelligence functions. You will define the topics on which CXG should have a distinctive and credible point of view, turn CXG's proprietary data, expertise and market knowledge into original external content, and position the company ahead of emerging developments in customer experience, luxury and its priority verticals.

This is a hands-on role: you will research, analyse, write and produce content yourself, while mobilising expertise and data from across the business. You will be accountable for ensuring that every publication presents a recognisable CXG angle rather than simply reporting market developments or repeating established industry views. You will manage one Market Intelligence team member.

Thought Leadership Development

  • Define the thought leadership strategy and roadmap, including priority themes, target audiences, formats and a realistic publication calendar.
  • Drive and coordinate content creation across Practices, Solutions and Regions.
  • Work closely with Practices, Regions and Solutions to:
    • Push: scan for trends and hot topics and ensure CXG has a voice and perspective, commenting regularly on these subjects.
    • Pull: identify and collect new ideas and proposed topics from the relevant stakeholders, prioritise and incorporate them into the thought leadership roadmap.
  • Use market intelligence, CXG's proprietary data, internal expertise and client-facing insights to identify emerging topics early, develop a clear CXG point of view and decide where CXG can make a credible contribution to the conversation.
  • Research, interview internal experts, write and edit articles, perspectives and other thought leadership content directly. Challenge generic claims and ensure each piece advances a clear argument and is supported by credible evidence.
  • Ensure that analysis is methodologically sound, appropriately contextualised and presented without compromising client confidentiality.
  • Develop topics that connect expertise across Practices and Regions, while reflecting relevant differences between markets.

Thought Leadership Communication

  • Ensure relevant thought leadership pieces (e.g., perspectives, publications) are disseminated on a periodic basis.
  • Work with Marketing on the publication, distribution and promotion of content, while retaining ownership of the editorial strategy, substance, quality and consistency of CXG's point of view. In addition, collaborate with Marketing to maximise impact by communicating through the channels relevant to each market.
  • Track the reach, engagement and qualitative response generated by CXG's thought leadership, as well as relevant business enquiries influenced by published content. Use the findings to refine the roadmap.
  • Shape and host or contribute to CXG's podcast "The Luxury Edit", working with internal experts and guests to develop topics, prepare interviews and turn conversations into useful content.
  • Develop the content and key messages for CXG-hosted events and external conferences, panels and talks; act as a CXG speaker where appropriate; and work with internal experts to prepare other CXG speakers and turn the company's point of view into compelling presentations and discussion topics.
  • Look for and test new thought leadership formats (e.g., interactive reports, data visualisations, short-form video, newsletters, social-first content) to broaden reach, engage new audiences and keep CXG's content distinctive.
  • Identify and build collaborations with conferences, specialised industry magazines and universities (e.g., content partnerships, guest articles, co-branded publications, joint research, guest lectures, speaking slots) to extend CXG's visibility and credibility with target audiences.

Market Intelligence

  • Keep abreast of market and competitive developments and ensure relevant findings are communicated across CXG.
  • Translate these findings into clear implications for CXG's strategic priorities, client conversations, commercial opportunities and external thought leadership.
  • Contribute market intelligence, evidence and relevant CXG perspectives to priority proposals and client deliverables, working with Practices, Solutions and Regions to strengthen the quality and relevance of the final output.
  • Manage and develop the Market Intelligence team member, setting clear priorities and reviewing the quality and usefulness of their work.

Competitive Analysis

  • Develop and continuously update a list of CXG competitors.
  • Research competitor performance, including revenues and market share where reliable information is available.
  • Identify and assess the impact of new competitors' offerings.
  • Review competitors' thought leadership, influence and presence.
  • Identify gaps in the conversations competitors are leading and opportunities for CXG to establish a distinct position.

Industry Analysis

  • Research and review clients' developments (e.g., new strategy, launch of new product or service, restructuring, M&A, key managerial appointments).
  • Track public financial announcements (e.g., quarterly and annual earnings).
  • Monitor developments in luxury, retail, customer experience and adjacent sectors; distinguish lasting shifts from short-lived topics and explain their implications for CXG and its clients.
  • Publish the weekly "This Week in Luxury" news brief and issue timely flash updates when significant developments require immediate attention, such as financial announcements, major transactions or leadership changes.

Internal Dissemination and Application

  • Synthesise research and findings into concise, actionable outputs tailored to the needs of relevant internal stakeholders. Feed findings into the Thought Leadership roadmap.
  • Proactively bring relevant market signals to Practices, Regions and leadership early enough to inform decisions, client conversations and potential cross-practice opportunities.
  • Disseminate new thought leadership across CXG and equip Practices, Regions and client-facing teams with the key messages and supporting materials needed to use it in client conversations and commercial activities.

Requirements

What will you bring along?

    • Proven experience developing thought leadership, editorial content or insight-led communications in a consulting, research, customer experience, retail or luxury environment.
    • Excellent English writing and editing skills, with a portfolio demonstrating original, well-argued, evidence-led articles or publications written personally. If possible, include examples that turn proprietary research, data or specialist expertise into a distinctive point of view. Additional languages (e.g., French, Mandarin) are a plus.
    • Strong oral communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to represent CXG as a speaker at conferences, panels and client events.
    • Proven ability to build relationships and influence senior stakeholders across functions and regions without direct authority.
    • An established network or demonstrated ability to build partnerships with media, conference organisers, academic institutions or industry bodies.
    • Comfort working with quantitative data and research methods, and the ability to translate data into clear, credible narratives and visualisations.
    • Ability to define and track content performance indicators and use them to refine editorial priorities.
    • Strong research and analytical skills: able to assess sources critically, connect market signals and form a clear point of view rather than simply summarise trends.
    • Familiarity with AI-assisted research and content tools, used with appropriate rigour.
    • Sound knowledge of luxury, retail and customer experience, and curiosity about how these sectors are evolving across markets.
    • Ability to interview senior experts, challenge ideas constructively and turn specialist knowledge into accessible, credible content.
    • Comfort working independently in a remote setting, managing an editorial roadmap and delivering finished work without a large production team.
    • Experience managing or coaching at least one team member.
    • Confidence preparing and hosting interviews or podcasts is a plus.

Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

Health is complex, personal, and deeply important to our members. As the voice of Lucis clients, you support them throughout their health journey and own member happiness end to end.

With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Lead. You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team.

What you will own

  • Member support: Resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat, email and phone, with warmth, precision and a sense of urgency.

  • Phone-first when it matters: Pick up the phone whenever a situation calls for a human voice: a delayed result, a stressful moment, a confused member.

  • Know your boundaries: Work hand in hand with our medical team and know exactly when to escalate a health question rather than answer it yourself.

  • Voice of the member: Spot recurring issues and turn them into clear, structured feedback for the product and ops teams.

  • Contribute to projects: Take part in initiatives that improve the member experience, like rebuilding our Help Center, designing proactive care for lab delays, or automating repetitive workflows with AI.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • Experience: 1+ years in B2C customer care, support, hospitality, or any role where you dealt directly with customers. Strong recent graduates with relevant experience are welcome too.

  • Bilingual: Fluent in both English and French, written and spoken.

  • People-first energy: You bring genuine warmth and empathy to every interaction, and you turn routine support into memorable experiences.

  • Rigorous precision: Exceptional attention to detail, with zero tolerance for misquotes, wrong information or operational errors. In health, accuracy is care.

  • Builder mindset: When something breaks twice, your instinct is to fix the root cause, not just the ticket.

Nice to have

  • Support tooling: You've used Intercom or similar support tools.

  • AI automation: You've already used AI tools to automate part of your work.

  • Startup mindset: You thrive in early-stage environments with high autonomy, rapid execution and clear communication.

 

The process

  • Intro call, culture & role fit (20 min)

  • Case study interview (30-60 min)

  • Deep dive and team chat, on-site (2 hours)

  • Reference calls

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location:

Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).

About the role:

As Head of Security, you'll define and drive Morpho's security strategy across the entire organization - corporate IT, cloud and infrastructure, application, supply chain, identity, incident response, threat intelligence, and counterparty security - and you'll build the team and function to deliver it. This is a hands-on leadership role: in the early days you'll personally do the work while you hire, and you'll stay close enough to the technical detail to earn the trust of a deeply technical organization. You'll also be Morpho's credible security voice, internally to leadership, and externally to the integrators, institutions, and ecosystem partners who depend on us. You'll partner closely with Engineering on infrastructure and deployment integrity, and with our Integration team, which works with various partners across the Morpho ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and continuously evolve Morpho's security strategy and roadmap across, cloud/infrastructure, application, supply-chain, identity, and operational security.

  • Build and lead the security function - hire, grow, and develop the team, recruiting skillsets across security operations and application security.

  • Oversight of the IT function

  • Stay hands-on. Personally execute critical security work - threat modeling, architecture review, control implementation, and incident command - while the team scales.

  • Set the governance architecture: a coherent security framework that ties tooling and controls together, rather than accumulating tools in isolation.

  • Own incident response end to end - runbooks, incident command, severity and escalation structure, and market communication during an event.

  • Build and run a counterparty security program for curators and partners - identity verification, screening, operational diligence, and bidirectional incident-coordination channels.

  • Lead Morpho's certification strategy (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001), meeting both the spirit and the letter sustainably.

  • Represent Morpho's security posture externally - to fintechs, financial institutions, and the broader ecosystem - and internally to executives.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Protocol, and Integrations, driving security outcomes through both direct ownership and influence.

What Success Looks Like:

First 30 Days

  • You've built a clear, independent picture of Morpho's posture, architecture, threat model, and in-flight work - and pressure-tested the existing strategy against it.

  • You've met the team and established working relationships with the people who own the surfaces you'll most depend on.

  • You understand the path-to-funds attack surface in depth and have an early, evidence-based view of the highest-severity risks and quick wins.

  • You know exactly where incident-response readiness stands today.

First 60 Days

  • You've published a clearly prioritized security roadmap with clear sequencing, owners, and the rationale for what's deferred and aligned leadership behind it.

  • You've defined the team build-out plan and opened the first hire.

  • You're personally driving the top-severity gaps - identity and authentication enforcement, deployment guardrails, and a documented incident-response runbook among them.

  • You've set the governance framework and the certification path in motion.

First 90 Days

  • Demonstrable progress closing the highest-priority gaps, with key controls enforced rather than optional.

  • A documented incident-response capability that's been validated by at least one tabletop exercise.

  • Hiring underway, and a clear operating rhythm established with Engineering, Protocol, and Integrations.

  • Morpho's external security posture is taking shape - trust surface, counterparty security program, and ecosystem engagement - and you're recognized internally and externally as Morpho's credible security voice.

Must-have Experience & Skills:

  • 10+ years in security, several of them building or leading a security function, ideally at a crypto/web3, fintech, or financial-services company where security is core to the business.

  • Strong grasp of the crypto/web3 threat model

  • Proven experience building and growing a security team from a small base, recruiting across security operations and application/infrastructure security.

  • Deep, hands-on technical expertise across cloud, infrastructure, CI/CD, supply-chain, identity, and application security - you do the work, not just direct it.

  • Owned incident response end to end, including incident command and external communication.

  • Sharp prioritization and the ability to galvanize action through hard and soft influence, including driving outcomes through teams you don't own.

  • Exceptional, organized, responsive communication - credible to executives and to external audiences from fintechs to Fortune 500 institutions.

  • Humble.

Nice to Have:

  • An established network and public profile in the security or crypto-security community, and comfort representing security work publicly (talks, writing, framework contribution).

  • Offensive security depth, or experience standing up red/blue capabilities.

  • Familiarity with institutional and regulatory expectations and threat-sharing networks (e.g. Crypto ISAC, TIBER-style frameworks).

  • Taken an organization through certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or equivalent)

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.
