data.title: Finance Manager, Financial Control & Accounting
data.description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

💰 Our Finance team

The Finance team ensures Joko's financial health and long-term success. We manage everything from financial planning and accounting to financing and cash management.

We make sure every euro is put to its best use, working closely with all teams, we provide the insights and structure needed to scale efficiently.

As we scale, we're splitting Finance into three specialized poles: FP&A, Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting), and Procurement. This role anchors Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) — the pole that keeps Joko's financial information accurate, timely, and audit-ready. You'll report directly to Quentin, our COO.

 

✨ Why this role is special

Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) is a brand-new specialized pole at Joko — previously bundled into a single generalist Finance Manager role. You'll be the first person to own this scope end to end, with direct visibility to the COO and VP Finance with real influence over how the function is built as the company scales past 200 people across multiple geographies.

  • You set the standards, not just follow them: as the pole's first hire, the processes, controls, and calendar you establish now become the backbone the rest of Finance builds on.

  • A true partner in automation: you'll work hand-in-hand with a dedicated BizOps partner to automate what can be automated — this isn't a role where you're expected to grind through manual work alone.

  • International scope from day one: France, the US, and future markets — you'll help build the multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as Joko expands.

 

🎯 What you will do

As Finance Manager, Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting), your main mission is to own the reliability, timeliness, and completeness of Joko's financial information. Rather than doing the bookkeeping — we have an external accounting partner for that — you set the standards, drive the calendar, and hold your internal and external stakeholders accountable.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Drive the closing calendar: own the monthly and annual closing calendar, holding our external accounting partner and auditors to a high standard;

  • Own our legal reporting package: make sure the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement are always accurate and delivered on time;

  • Oversee AP/AR end to end: keep invoicing, payment runs, and collections under control;

  • Lead our international accounting build-out: as we open new entities and markets, including our IFRS consolidation framework;

  • Own cash management: reconciliation, yield optimization, and day-to-day treasury;

  • Be the main point of contact for our banking and accounting partners, and a key interface for auditors as we scale toward IPO readiness;

  • Continuously strengthen and document our financial processes and controls, working hand-in-hand with a dedicated BizOps partner to automate what can be automated, making everything more robust and less error-prone as the company scales.

 

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: 4–8 years, with a strong foundation in accounting or audit (Big 4 or equivalent), ideally combined with in-house experience in a scale-up.

  • Education: A master's degree from a top business school. A double degree in accounting (DCG/DSCG) is a plus.

  • Financial rigor: Deep understanding of French GAAP and treasury fundamentals — you bring the same discipline to a closing cycle as you do to a cash position.

  • International mindset: Excited to build a multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as we expand; IFRS exposure is a plus.

  • Stakeholder management: You build trust with partners inside and outside Joko, and you're comfortable holding them accountable.

  • Problem solving: You dig into the root cause and fix things.

  • AI centricity: You use AI in your daily work today, and you're excited to help automate reporting and reconciliation as part of Joko's AI-first finance ambition.

  • Languages: Fluent French and English.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €61.5K – €84K

data.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform
data.description:
The Senior Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform is responsible for building, running, and evolving the ML monorepo used by the X-ray, CT, and MRI machine learning group at DeepHealth. The monorepo covers the full path from experimentation to product: dataset and sample definitions, training and evaluation code, experiment tracking, model export, and the inference servers that run in production. Everyone on the team contributes to the monorepo; this role is the single point of accountability for it. This hands-on role owns the architecture, tooling, and engineering standards of that codebase for a distributed team of about twenty machine learning engineers and scientists, working with model developers and software engineers to make the team’s work fast, better, and easier to audit. It also leads the team's agentic coding strategy, shaping how AI coding agents are used across the codebase. The role reports to the Leader of the ML for X-ray/CT/MRI group.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities  

  • Own the architecture and roadmap of the ML Monorepo:

    • Module boundaries, shared abstractions for datasets and samples, training and evaluation loops, configuration, and experiment tracking.

  • Build and run the engineering tooling around the codebase:

    • Continuous integration, testing, dependency management, containers, artifact and model registries, and GPU job scheduling on cloud (GCP) and HPC infrastructure.

  • Own the path from trained checkpoint to deployable model:

    • Model packaging, inference servers with enforced API contracts, reproducibility, and performance and memory budgets on target hardware.

  • Define and enforce engineering standards (code review, testing, documentation) in a way that accelerates research rather than slowing it down.

  • Ensure traceability of data, code, and model versions across experiments and releases.

  • Investigate and resolve performance, reliability, and usability issues in the stack raised by the team and reduce their recurrence through shared tooling.

  • Drive the team's agentic coding strategy: define how AI coding agents are used in the monorepo, set up the tooling, guardrails, and conventions that make them effective, and help colleagues adopt them.

  • Review code, mentor colleagues on engineering practices, and communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above.  Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.


Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience 

  • Master's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (required).

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including a significant portion building infrastructure or tooling used by machine learning teams, such as an ML platform or a training framework (required).

  • Strong Python skills and software engineering fundamentals: API design, testing, refactoring, and attention to developer experience (required).

  • Solid PyTorch knowledge and practical experience with model training and profiling (required).

  • Experience running ML workloads on a cloud platform, ideally GCP (Vertex AI, Artifact Registry, IAM, storage), and with containerization (required).

  • Experience taking models to production: model packaging, inference serving, and performance and reliability constraints (required).

  • Ability to work closely with researchers, translate recurring pain points into shared tooling, and push back constructively when needed (required).

  • Ability to work autonomously in a distributed, multi-site team, with clear verbal and written communication in English (required).

  • Medical imaging experience (DICOM, 3D volumes, large images) (preferred).

  • HPC and Slurm experience (preferred).

  • Contributions to open-source ML tooling (preferred).

Quality Standards 

  • Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors. 

  • Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.  

  • Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

  • Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.

  • Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times. 

  • Practices universal safety precautions.

  • Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person. 

  • Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems. 

  • Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

  • Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Travel

This position may require occasional travel between team sites (Paris, the Netherlands, Grenoble/Rennes).

Working Environment 

Office / Hybrid. Paris, Île-de-France, France.

Physical Demands 

The employee must be able to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Salary:

Dependent upon experience

50,000-80,000 EURO

  • Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.
  • Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.
  • Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.
  • Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.
  • Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.
  • Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.
  • Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.
  • Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.

Ce que nous recherchons

Indispensable

  • Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.
  • Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.
  • Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.
  • Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.
  • La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.
  • Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux.
  • La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer.
  • Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.
  • La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

Atouts

  • Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.
  • Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.

Rémunération

Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés.

Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :

  • Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.
  • Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.
  • Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.
  • Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.
  • Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.
  • Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.

Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer.

Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.

Formation et accompagnement

Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients.

Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.

Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation.

Young Graduate in Data and Software Engineering (Zurich, Switzerland)
data.description:
Who We Are

Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing Swiss AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We work with some of the biggest organizations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 300 projects and have grown to 190+ talented individuals across 10 office locations.


Unit8’s mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and “engineering for good” causes.

Requirements

What You’ll Do

Unit8 is welcoming young graduates for the opportunity to grow in Data and Software Engineering! Join us for a 6-month paid professional experience in building industrial Data and AI solutions. You can start asap, with direct exposure to clients' needs and opportunities to participate in learning activities such as Reading Groups and Knowledge Sharing Sessions. In addition, each young graduate will be accompanied by a dedicated wingmate/mentor who will guide and help them build their technical growth vision.


As a young graduate you will join a team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and Cloud Engineers who work hand-in-hand with our customers on designing and implementing their industry-specific use cases. You will be directly involved in discussing the client’s challenges and needs and will have chances to develop your client-facing skills. You will be responsible for developing, deploying, and automating our AI services and cloud infrastructure. You will also learn to carefully analyse a given problem and apply the relevant tools and techniques to solve it.

In general you will:

  • use software best practices in continuous integration and delivery, versioning and automation;
  • use your skills to build and maintain service and data infrastructure;
  • participate as junior engineer in all phases of the software development life cycle - planning, implementation, deployment, testing and maintenance;

Are You the team member we are looking for?

In order to be successful in this role, you are/have:

  • motivated and eager to learn different aspects of engineering
  • comfortable interacting with technical and business people
  • strong communication and presentation skills
  • recently graduated/finishing your MSc or BSc in Computer Science or related major;
  • familiar with version control and collaboration tooling (git)
  • familiar with CI/CD frameworks and automated deployment concepts (i.e Docker, K8s)
  • fluent in both English and German
  • available for a minimum of 32h a week.
  • ready to start on the 1st of February

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Exposure to a wide variety of projects, industries, and technologies. Each client is different and provides unique opportunities to learn.
  • Ability to contribute to internal open-source projects like Darts (https://github.com/unit8co/darts)
  • Learning activities such as ML Reading Group, knowledge sharing sessions with engineers.
  • Training-on-the-job and your personal wingmate/mentor
  • 15 paid days of holiday
  • Be part of an international team of more than 20 nationalities.
  • up to 10% of paid time for self-development.
  • Flexible working hours, including some home office.
  • Cross offices/company-wide frequent events like offsites.
  • If you are successful, opportunity to be then hired for a permanent position.

data.title: Palantir Foundry Engineer (Relocation to Abu Dhabi, UAE)
data.description:
Who We Are

Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a Swiss data and AI consulting company helping organisations in traditional industries solve complex challenges in areas such as operations, finance, manufacturing and R&D. We work at the intersection of technology and business, delivering data and AI solutions that create practical value for our clients.

Our teams have delivered projects across industries including automotive, chemicals, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We are a Palantir partner and work with clients across the full data and AI journey, from understanding a business problem to building and deploying the solution.

Unit8 has delivered more than 300 projects and grown to a team of 190+ talented people across ten office locations. Following our growth across Europe and our expansion into North America, we are now building our presence in the United Arab Emirates. We are looking for a Palantir Foundry Engineer to join us in Abu Dhabi. This role is based in the UAE and includes relocation from Switzerland with full immigration and relocation support.

Requirements

About the Role

As one of the first members of Unit8’s team in the UAE, you will help deliver Foundry solutions for clients while contributing to the growth of our presence in the region.

You will work directly with client teams to understand their data and operational challenges, then design and build solutions that address them. The role combines hands-on engineering with close collaboration across business and technical teams. You will also contribute your technical perspective during early client discussions and help shape practical approaches to new opportunities.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, deploy and maintain data solutions using Palantir Foundry.
  • Develop and troubleshoot data pipelines and processing systems using Foundry and relevant open-source or proprietary technologies.
  • Build and maintain Foundry components such as Ontologies, pipelines, and user-facing applications.
  • Apply sound engineering practices for testing, data quality, performance, security and maintainability.
  • Work with client stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify problems and translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, product owners and client teams in an agile environment.
  • Contribute to technical discovery and solution scoping for prospective and ongoing engagements.
  • Help establish Unit8’s engineering and delivery approach in the UAE, sharing knowledge with colleagues and supporting the growth of the local team.

About You

We are looking for an experienced Palantir Foundry Engineer with a passion for data and solving complex client challenges. You should be a skilled professional who has:

* Foundry Platform Knowledge

    • Demonstrated experience with AIP, Workshop, Code repository, and Pipeline Builder.
    • A solid understanding of security concepts within Foundry, including restricted views and markings.
    • Knowledge of Ontology and Data connection.
    • We're interested in the technical details of what you've built and how you approached the architecture of your Foundry use-cases.

* Programming Skills - proficiency in Python and PySpark.

* Data Skills (Nice-to-have) - knowledge of data modeling and basic concepts of data science (classification, clustering, regression).

* Professional Experience

  • A minimum of 1 year of experience working with the Foundry platform, ideally within a larger company where you may have had a focused but deep exposure.
  • Strong client-facing skills: You are comfortable interacting with both business and technical clients, giving presentations, and possess a strong problem-solving mindset.

* Other

  • You are willing to travel to meet with our clients and the team

Benefits

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to help establish Unit8’s presence in a new market.
  • Hands-on work on client challenges with tangible business impact.
  • Exposure to different industries, projects and technologies.
  • A collaborative team environment with colleagues across Switzerland, Europe and North America.
  • Mentorship and opportunities to develop your technical and consulting skills.
  • Full immigration support for your move to the UAE.
  • Relocation support, including accommodation and travel allowances.
  • Opportunities to contribute to knowledge sharing and projects with a positive impact.

data.description:
Rotzinger Transver mit Standorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf in der Schweiz ist ein führender Anbieter von Lösungen für Produktflusssteuerung, Pufferung, Verteilung und Fördertechnik für die Lebensmittel-, Süsswaren- und Verpackungsindustrie.

Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden.

Nach einer intensiven internen Einarbeitungsphase (Vormontage und Anlagenmontage) unterstützen Sie unser Team als erfahrener Field Engineer.


So schaffen Sie Mehrwert

  • Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben zählen neben selbst durchgeführten mechanischen Montagetätigkeiten, die personelle und fachliche Führung von kleineren bis mittleren Montageteams.

  • Bereitschaft für Montageeinsätze im In- und Ausland (Reisetätigkeit bis zu 60 %)

  • Verantwortlich für die fach- und termingerechte Montage beim Kunden

  • Als Bindeglied zwischen Kunde, Lieferant und interner Projektleitung sind sie es gewohnt präzise zu kommunizieren

  • Durchführen der Abnahmevalidierungen unserer eigenen mechanischen Analgenteile zur Qualitäts- und Gefahrenkontrolle.

  • Ihre ausgeprägten Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Koordination, Organisation und Überwachung verhelfen Ihnen zu einer erfolgreichen Bewältigung dieser anspruchsvollen Tätigkeit.


Ihr Profil

  • Abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Mechaniker oder Anlagen- und Apparatebauer mit einigen Jahren Berufserfahrung

  • Sie bringen einige Jahre Praxiserfahrung als leitender Monteur für mechanische Anlagen / Maschinen mit

  • Muttersprache Deutsch, gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere Sprachkenntnisse von Vorteil

  • Sie verfügen über gute PC-Kenntnisse in MS Office, AutoCAD DWG Viewer

  • Offene, selbständige, flexible und belastbare Persönlichkeit

Unser Angebot

  • Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld

  • Ein motiviertes Team

Es erwartet Sie eine vielseitige Tätigkeit in einem agilen KMU, das Freiraum für Kreativität und Weiterentwicklung gibt.

data.description:
IN SHORT

Are you a versatile problem-solver who wants to write software that impacts the physical world? As a Full Stack Software Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will be at the core of our operations, building systems that touch everything from warehouse automation to customer-facing smart fridges.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Take ownership of warehouse and supplier web apps used daily for inbound processing, picking, labeling, and inventory.
  • Develop and maintain our internal back-office tool, including the backend and GraphQL API that runs menus, deliveries, inventory, and customer sites.
  • Manage the service connecting automated picking lanes to the rest of the system to ensure uninterrupted warehouse operations.
  • Maintain and update the Point of Sale Android app running on hundreds of fridges, managing the release process for the entire fleet.
  • Integrate and support payment systems (Card, TWINT), our ERP, and other partner integrations.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to debug live issues directly alongside the operations team.
  • Visit the warehouse on-site to test changes and gather feedback from the people actually using the software.
  • Translate vague problems from non-technical colleagues into shipped solutions without needing them broken down first.
  • Own production deployments, managing logs, alerts, and careful rollouts with clear rollback plans.
  • Break down larger features, review other engineers' pull requests, and proactively maintain system health through upgrades, testing, and cleanup.


YOUR PROFILE

  • Proven production experience in at least one typed backend language (such as C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, or TypeScript) and one modern frontend framework.
  • Track record of successfully owning software in production, including on-call duties, debugging from logs, and resolving live issues while users wait.
  • Familiarity with or willingness to dive into C#, TypeScript, Android, and Kotlin.
  • Prior exposure to hardware, IoT, edge devices, payments, logistics, retail operations, or Odoo environments is highly advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to dive into unfamiliar tech stacks, learn quickly, and ship reliable code.
  • Strong passion for collaborating directly with end-users, including warehouse and operations staff, rather than exclusively with other engineers.
  • High degree of curiosity and a proactive mindset to take full ownership of problems from end to end.
  • Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken); knowledge of German or French is a plus.
  • Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.
  • Valid work permit or Swiss passport.


OUR BENEFITS

  • Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true
  • Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine
  • 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation 
  • Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day
  • We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund
  • New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.
  • We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard
  • Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing
  • Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions
 
Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English.


ABOUT US

FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality. 
With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).

FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York.

data.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
data.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in Netherlands

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

  • Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts
  • Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident
  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal
  • Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara's investigation processes, with proficiency in Python
  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis
  • Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams
  • Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews
  • Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services
  • Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.
  • This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team

An ideal candidate also has:

  • 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification
  • Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the Programme

This is a structured 18–24 month global programme designed to launch high-potential commercial careers. You don’t need prior sales or payments experience; what you need is ambition, curiosity, resilience, and the drive to build relationships and solve complex problems.

You will join a global cohort of Business Development Representatives (BDRs) with structured learning, dedicated coaching from sales leaders, and real commercial responsibility from month one. Throughout the programme, you will master enterprise sales: researching strategic accounts, engaging senior decision-makers, conducting sharp discovery conversations, and building pipeline that drives real business growth.

High performers transition into Sales, Account Management, and other commercial roles across the business. Many of our top commercial leaders, including our Chief Revenue Officer, started their journey at Checkout.com as BDRs or interns. Whether you are a recent graduate, an early-career professional with 1–3 years of experience, or a career switcher, what matters most is your hunger to learn and achieve.

What You’ll Do

  • Research Strategic Accounts: Identify high-value targets by researching key organizations, industries, and executive stakeholders.

  • Initiate High-Impact Outreach: Open doors with senior decision-makers using personalized outreach across email, phone, and LinkedIn.

  • Build Qualified Pipeline: Drive consistent growth momentum through disciplined prospecting, rigorous follow-up, and account mapping.

  • Run Consultative Discovery: Uncover merchants' technical and business challenges to align Checkout.com’s solutions with their goals.

  • Partner on Live Deals: Work alongside Sales Representatives to support opportunities through to deal execution.

  • Leverage AI & Modern Tech: Use CRM, intent data, and approved AI tools to streamline research, refine outreach, and work smarter.

Who We’re Looking For

We welcome applications from recent graduates and professionals with 1–3 years of experience looking to change careers. Regardless of your background, we are looking for the following core skills to set you up for success:

  • Driven & Goal-Oriented: You set high personal standards, work hard, and stay motivated when tackling challenging commercial goals.

  • Resilient & Adaptable: You bounce back quickly from rejection, view obstacles as practice, and maintain consistent output.

  • Relational & Engaging: You genuinely enjoy starting conversations, asking sharp questions, and building trust with diverse stakeholders.

  • Track Record of Achievement: You demonstrate drive and ownership through professional, academic, athletic, or entrepreneurial success.

  • Commercial & Tech Curiosity: You are eager to learn complex fintech products and use AI and sales tools to work smarter.

  • Coachability & Clear Communication: You listen well, articulate ideas clearly, and actively apply feedback to improve performance.

What You’ll Get Out of It

A 2-year structured programme that ensures you have a successful career in sales. A clear progression pathway built around key pillars:

  • Fintech & Enterprise Sales Mastery: Build deep expertise in global payments, digital commerce, and complex deal execution alongside experienced Account Executives.

  • AI-Native Commercial Skills: Master modern sales tools, intent data, and AI to automate routine tasks and focus on high-impact prospecting.

  • Coaching & Leadership Growth: Receive 1:1 mentorship from sales leaders, earn certifications, and take on senior BDR responsibilities, from mentoring peers to working on live deals through pricing and signing

  • Direct Career Acceleration: Graduate with a tight-knit global network and a direct pathway into Account Executive, Account Management, or Commercial Strategy roles.

Want to Stand Out?

When we review your CV, ensure you show us why you're great for this role. Ensure and share something you’ve built, led or achieved, whether that’s hitting a target, launching a side project, or leading a team effort.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

  • Who should apply? Recent graduates, early-career professionals (1–3 years experience), and career changers with strong commercial drive.

  • When does the programme start? We have start dates in March and September 2027.

  • What is the application deadline? Apply early for the best chance of being reviewed. We will close once we receive a sufficient number of applications.

  • Where are the roles located? We have roles in London, New York, Barcelona, Amsterdam, Riyadh, Dubai, and Shanghai.

  • Do I need a second language? Fluent English is required. Specific local language proficiency may be required depending on the hiring region.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

data.title: Lead AI Engineer
data.description:
We are AI builders

Since 2018, Enjins has done one thing: ship AI that works in production. From Utrecht and Berlin, we build machine learning systems, data infrastructure, and agentic AI layers for European tech companies, with a deliberate focus on climate and energy, where we believe the biggest technological shift of our generation should meet its most critical challenge.

We embed directly with the engineering teams of high-growth scale-ups like Crisp, PlanBlue, NextSense, and Groendus. We take ownership of the full technical lifecycle: from first architecture decision to a production-grade system running inside our partner's infrastructure, long after go-live.

The role

As Lead AI Engineer, you are the technical owner of client engagements. You architect the solution, ship it to production, and make sure it still performs a year later. Alongside the other Leads, you shape the engineering team and the way we build.

In practice:

  • Design AI roadmaps with client leadership and own them through to production
  • Create and implement the AI solution architectures to deliver on those roadmaps
  • Set and uphold Data Platform and MLOps standards across your client portfolio, so systems stay healthy after handover
  • Mentor engineers and weigh in on hiring, team growth, and accounts
  • Push our engineering practice forward, including how we use agentic coding workflows to build faster without compromising reliability. We test, document, and share what works, so the whole team levels up
  • Elevate our product mindset to ensure we build the right things, not just more things

Why a Lead role here, not somewhere else

You'll work across more stacks, clouds, and frontier frameworks in a year than most engineers see in five, with the collective knowledge of the whole team behind you, not the isolation of freelance work. And because our clients build grid software, energy forecasting, and climate infrastructure, you develop real domain expertise in energy and climate systems on top of production-grade AI engineering.

In your first months you'll join a client project alongside an experienced Enjins engineer, supported by a dedicated coach. Within half a year, you own the technical roadmap of at least one engagement, mentor engineers, and have a recognised voice in our Asset strategy.

Requirements

What matters most: you think in systems, own outcomes end-to-end, and grow the people around you.

  • 5+ years building and scaling data & AI solutions in production environments
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: you write production-grade code and know your way around infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, data pipelines)
  • Mastery of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience leading MLOps/LLMOps architectures
  • Proven experience taking LLM-based or agentic systems to production
  • Experience mentoring engineers, overseeing delivery, and managing client accounts
  • You can translate technical complexity into clear decisions for non-technical stakeholders
  • Fluent in English and eligible to work in the Netherlands

Benefits

We publish our salary ranges and keep terms straightforward. No surprises.

Compensation

  • €5,950 - €7,800 gross per month (excl. holiday allowance, pension, bonus, equity, and AI-Leap benefits)
  • Annual performance bonus of 1.5 months' salary
  • Equity participation (VSOP)


Growth

  • AI-Leap: our structured development programme with a dedicated certification budget and a specialised track for Leads
  • 1-on-1 mentoring with our founders and external coaching to close your specific gaps


Team & culture

  • Office on the Oudegracht in Utrecht (note: not yet fully accessible for individuals with physical disabilities); hybrid setup
  • 28 vacation days, flexible across 3 national holidays
  • Monthly team events and the annual two-day Enjins Summer Summit on AI × Climate
  • OV-First travel policy, fully covered; meat-free catering
  • Apple MacBook Pro and the tools you need

data.description:
Functieprofiel

Als Process Automation Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het hart van onze productieomgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, onderhouden en continu verbeteren van het procesautomatiseringslandschap (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3 – zowel hardware als software).

Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie.

Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste.


Wat ga jij doen!

In deze dynamische rol houd je je bezig met:

  • Beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van procesautomatiseringssystemen (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3)

  • Continu verbeteren van het NX Production Data Platform

  • Initiëren, uitwerken en implementeren van technische verbeteringen en procesoptimalisaties

  • Ondersteunen van Operations bij automatiseringsincidenten, inclusief deelname aan de storingsdienst

  • Zorgen voor een hoge beschikbaarheid en kwaliteit van productie‑ en QC‑data en actieve ondersteuning van data‑analyses

  • Voorstellen van automatisering‑ en digitaliseringsprojecten en – na goedkeuring – deze voorbereiden en uitvoeren

  • Adviseren van de organisatie over nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en toekomstbestendige oplossingen

  • Actief bijdragen aan het versterken van cybersecurity binnen het OT‑domein

Wat wij vragen!

  • Jij bent een proactieve automatiseringsprofessional met een passie voor technologie en verbetering:

  • Een afgeronde bachelor‑ of masteropleiding in Informatica, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting

  • Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in procesautomatisering

  • Hands‑on ervaring met Siemens Step7 / TIA Portal / WinCC

  • Ervaring met ProLeiT Plant.iT

  • Bij voorkeur ervaring met OPC UA en AVEVA PI

  • De bereidheid om jezelf én de organisatie continu te blijven ontwikkelen


Wat bieden wij jou!

Werken bij NX Filtration biedt je de kans om samen met een gedreven en enthousiast team een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de professionalisering en groei van de organisatie. Je werkt in een open en informele omgeving met zeer korte communicatielijnen, waarin eigen initiatief wordt gestimuleerd.

Het betreft een zelfstandige functie binnen een snelgroeiende, dynamische organisatie in een internationale setting, waar je volop ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen – zowel persoonlijk als in je loopbaanambities.

Daarnaast:

data.title: Product Manager
data.description:
Role summary

Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day.

We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted.

Responsibilities

  • Product vision, grounded in real user needs

You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind.

  • Market scoping and opportunity-spotting

Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog.

  • Logistics know-how turned into product decisions 

Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you.

  • The full lifecycle

From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear.

  • The connective tissue across the company 

When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together.

The team you’ll join

You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today.

Life at Bluerock

We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock.


  • 5+ years in product or project management within logistics, supply chain, or TMS — hands-on TMS experience is required.

  • Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field  required.

  • A track record of delivering complex, high-stakes software implementations, on time and within budget.

  • Genuine ease operating cross-functionally. You connect engineering, sales, implementation, and customers without waiting for permission.

  • An appetite for ambiguity and change: a messy, fragmented workflow reads to you as an interesting problem.

  • Nice to have: API integration experience (WMS, ERP, visibility providers, customs), fluency with Agile tooling (Jira, Asana, Rocketlane), and PMP/PRINCE2 certification.

  • Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage customer relationships and stakeholder expectations effectively.

  • Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on delivering results in a fast-paced environment

Our hiring process

  • Hit the Apply button.

  • Join a 30 minute video call in the Introduction Interview

  • A couple of deeper interviews built to be a win-win, not an interrogation.

  • An offer, and the start of your journey with Bluerock TMS.


Bluerock TMS is an equal opportunities employer. We take pride in our diverse workforce and inclusive workplace. Within a small team of open-minded talents, we ensure an attractive learning environment that you are looking for!

data.title: Senior interim manager in de zorg in loondienst
data.description:
Ben jij een ervaren leider die energie krijgt van het aanbrengen van structuur in uitdagende situaties? Hou je ervan om orde op zaken te stellen en daarna door te gaan naar de volgende interne opdracht? Word jij blij van de afwisseling en uitdaging van een projectmatige rol en met de zekerheid en voordelen van een baan in loondienst? Dan is deze rol als interim manager bij Cordaan iets voor jou! 

Wat ga je doen? 
Als interim manager word je ingezet op locaties van Cordaan waar extra leiderschap en verandering nodig zijn. Dit betekent dat je tijdelijke projectmatige opdrachten uitvoert in de organisatie, waar je snel schakelt, structuur aanbrengt en teams in crisis helpt stabiliseren. Je start elke opdracht met het maken van een projectplan en zorgt dat dit succesvol wordt uitgevoerd. Je zorgt ervoor dat medewerkers optimaal kunnen functioneren en kwalitatieve zorg kunnen bieden. 

Jouw belangrijkste taken: 

  • Leidinggeven in complexe situaties: Je biedt duidelijkheid, hakt knopen door en creëert een veilige en gestructureerde werkomgeving. 

  • Verandermanagement: Je begeleidt afdelingen in transitie en zorgt voor blijvende verbeteringen in zorgkwaliteit en teamdynamiek. 

  • Bedrijfsvoering op orde brengen: Je monitort en rapporteert maandelijks over financiën, medewerkerstevredenheid en verloop. 

  • Samenwerking versterken: Je betrekt vrijwilligers, mantelzorgers en familieleden bij het welzijn van cliënten. 

  • Coachen en inspireren: Je helpt de collega’s op de locatie groeien, zodat zij hun werk met plezier en vertrouwen kunnen doen. 

Wat krijg je van ons? 
Bij Cordaan krijg je de kans om impact te maken binnen een kleurrijke organisatie die de ambitie heeft de beste zorgverlener en zorgwerkgever van Amsterdam te zijn. Voor deze functie zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden conform cao VVT: 

  • Een jaarcontract (32 - 36 uur per week) met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband; 

  • Salaris conform CAO VVT FWG 60: min. € 4.157 en max. € 6.171 bruto (o.b.v. 36 uur per week); 

  • Extra’s: Eindejaarsuitkering (8,33%) en vakantiegeld (8%); 

  • Reiskosten: een vergoeding á € 0,21 per km en een fietsplan; 

  • Pensioenopbouw via Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn;   

  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Volop mogelijkheden om je persoonlijk en professioneel te ontwikkelen;  

  • Collega aandragen? Ontvang in totaal een aanbrengbonus van € 500,- netto.


Wie ben jij? 
Jij bent een manager met een sterke persoonlijkheid en ruime ervaring in crisis- en verandermanagement in de zorg. Je kan projectmatig werken en weet hoe je teams motiveert en veranderingen succesvol implementeert. 

Verder heb je: 

  • Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring als leidinggevende; 

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in zorgmanagement, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting én een aanvullende cursus of opleiding gevolgd op het gebied van verander- en/of crisismanagement; 

  • Ervaring met begeleiding van meerdere verander- of crisismanagement trajecten in de zorg; 

  • Aantoonbare beheersing van minimaal 3 van de volgende competenties (blijkend uit recente talentenscan of 360⁰ feedback): resultaatgerichtheid, visie, verandermanagement en beïnvloedingskracht. 

Waar ga je werken? 
Als interim manager kun je ingezet worden binnen een van de verschillende zorgdomeinen van Cordaan in Amsterdam in de ouderenzorg, Jeugd, GGZ en gehandicaptenzorg. Je wordt flexibel ingezet op locaties waar tijdelijke versterking nodig is, zodat jij impact kunt maken waar het écht telt. 

Enthousiast?
Zie jij jezelf helemaal terug in bovenstaand profiel en hebben we jou geënthousiasmeerd met onze mooie unieke functie? Solliciteer dan direct online! Controleer altijd na het indienen van je sollicitatie of je een bevestiging in je (spam)mailbox ontvangen hebt.
Heb je vragen of wil je meer weten? Bel gerust even met onze recruiter: Marloes Alteveer via 06-4843 0289 of

Kleurrijk en betekenisvol met elkaar
Cordaan vindt een inclusief werving- en selectiebeleid belangrijk. We omarmen de eigenheid van collega’s en stimuleren ontwikkeling van talenten. We willen dat cliënten en collega's zichzelf herkennen in onze organisatie. Dit vraagt om een goede representatie van medewerkers en leidinggevenden met verschillende achtergronden. Cordaan streeft ernaar om meer mensen uit groepen die nog ondervertegenwoordigd zijn, aan te nemen en te behouden.

data.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
data.description:
As Optics11 continues to grow, we are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer – Hardware Design to take ownership of the mechanical hardware development of high-performance fiber-optic measurement systems used in demanding energy and marine environments.

At Optics11, we develop cutting-edge fiber-optic sensing solutions that make critical infrastructure and underwater security systems smarter, safer, and more reliable.

In this role, you will design ruggedized chassis, enclosures, and mechanical assemblies that protect and integrate electronic, photonic, fiber-optic, and electromechanical subsystems. You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams and external partners to develop robust, manufacturable, and serviceable hardware solutions that support integration, qualification, manufacturing, and long-term operation.

You will apply structured engineering methods, sound technical judgement, and rigorous verification practices to ensure products perform reliably under vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, and other environmental conditions.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the mechanical design and development of chassis, enclosures, mounting structures, and assemblies for fiber-optic measurement systems, from concept through qualification and release.

  • Collaborate with electronics, photonics, optical, and systems engineering teams to define PCB placement, optical component integration, fiber routing, interconnections, thermal interfaces, and packaging constraints.

  • Design robust hardware solutions that meet vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, environmental, serviceability, and lifecycle requirements for energy and marine applications.

  • Develop modular, maintainable, and upgradeable hardware architectures that support manufacturability, serviceability, and long-term product support.

  • Create and maintain engineering documentation, including drawings, specifications, design calculations, assembly instructions, and manufacturing documentation.

  • Manage technical collaboration with suppliers, manufacturers, OEMs, and external development partners to ensure performance, quality, manufacturability, and qualification requirements are met.

  • Support prototype development, subsystem integration, environmental and mechanical testing, product qualification, and release activities.

  • Analyze test results, performance margins, failure modes, and operational limits to improve product robustness, reliability, and design maturity.

  • Apply engineering analyses, trade-off studies, DfMA principles, simulation tools, and FEA to optimize mechanical, thermal, structural, dynamic, manufacturability, lifecycle, and cost performance.

  • Investigate qualification failures, manufacturing issues, integration challenges, and field performance topics using structured problem-solving and root cause analysis.

  • Provide technical input during design reviews, engineering discussions, development decisions, and cross-functional integration activities.

  • Plan and execute work in line with priorities, milestones, quality expectations, and timelines, while proactively communicating risks, dependencies, and recommendations.

  • Share expertise, lessons learned, and best practices to strengthen team capability, collaboration, product quality, reliability, and continuous improvement.

Why Join Us?

  • Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Fresh team lunches provided3 times/ week.


Qualifications:

  • MSc in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline with a focus on mechanical design of opto-electronic, electronic, photonic, or other high-tech hardware products.

  • 5+ years of experience in multidisciplinary product development environments.

  • Strong experience designing chassis, enclosures, hardware packaging solutions, and mechanical assemblies for high-performance products.

  • Proven track record in developing ruggedized opto-electronic hardware products from concept through qualification and release.

  • Strong understanding of vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, and environmental requirements for demanding operational environments.

  • Experience with 3D CAD tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, NX, or similar.

  • Experience creating engineering drawings, specifications, and manufacturing documentation.

  • Strong analytical mindset with experience in structured problem solving and engineering verification.

  • Strong communication skills in English and collaborative working style.

  • Eligible for EU/NATO security clearance.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with fiber-optic integration, optical component packaging, or photonic hardware development.

  • Experience with CE/FCC, MIL, NATO, and/or STANAG qualification standards.

  • Experience with ruggedized chassis standards used in defense, marine, aerospace, or industrial applications (e.g. VPX, CompactPCI, uTCA).

  • Experience managing external suppliers, manufacturers, and development partners.

  • Experience supporting environmental qualification, certification, or product compliance programs.

Please note that we can only consider candidates who are currently residing in the Netherlands and already have the legal right to work here without requiring visa sponsorship or a work permit.

data.title: Data & ML Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:

In this role, you will design, implement, and continuously improve a cloud-agnostic data and ML platform that supports multiple products and teams. You will be responsible for platform reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency, while providing data scientists and ML engineers with the tools and infrastructure to efficiently develop, train, validate, and deploy machine learning models. You will serve as a technical bridge between the data science and IT/infrastructure teams, translating requirements into robust and maintainable systems.

This role includes ownership of an existing vendor-delivered platform and its evolution into a fully automated, reproducible, and multi-product ML platform.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain the data and ML platform infrastructure, including systems for data ingestion, storage, processing, and training.

  • Ensure high availability, reliability, and uptime of the platform, as it is critical to the business value proposition.

  • Maintain and evolve vendor-delivered platform components and ensure long-term maintainability and independence.

  • Build and maintain data workflows, including tools for dataset versioning, experiment tracking, and model lifecycle management across multiple products.

data.title: IT Director
data.description:
At Optics11, we develop ultra-sensitive fibre optic sensing technology that helps protect maritime infrastructure and energy assets around the world. We are a fast-growing, mission-driven company with colleagues from more than twenty nationalities.

As we grow, we are looking for an IT Director to lead and develop the organisation that keeps Optics11 running and ready to scale. You will shape our IT direction, strengthen service delivery and build the team, architecture and operating model needed for the next phase of the company.

About the role

You will own IT strategy and delivery across Workplace and Support Services, Infrastructure, Cloud and Operational Technology, Enterprise Applications and Integration, and Product IT Operations. Your remit includes people, budget, suppliers, architecture, service management and continuity across these areas.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set direction and manage the team, while remaining close enough to the technology to make sound decisions and earn the trust of experienced specialists. You will introduce practical ITIL-based ways of working that make services predictable without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

The Security Office operates independently from IT and sets security requirements, architecture input and assurance expectations. Your team will implement and operate the technical controls assigned to IT. For products in the field, Customer Service will own the customer case and Product Engineering will own product design and engineering changes. Product IT Operations will provide the specialist operational IT capability between them.

What you will do

  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary IT team covering workplace support, infrastructure, cloud, operational technology, enterprise applications and Product IT Operations.

  • Own the IT strategy, architecture, roadmap and priorities, translating business needs into clear and achievable plans.

  • Establish an ITIL-aligned service model with one Service Desk, clear resolver groups, controlled changes, meaningful service levels and continual improvement.

  • Ensure the reliability and recoverability of workplace technology, identity services, endpoints, servers, cloud platforms, networks, backup and recovery.

  • Reduce reliance on individual experts through competent cover, documentation, secure access, knowledge transfer and tested recovery procedures.

  • Own the technical lifecycle of enterprise core applications and integrations, e.g. ERP, PLM, CRM. Business owners define processes and data requirements, while application champions and IT perform approved administration and changes.

  • Build Product IT Operations as a distinct service for the cloud, edge, connectivity and other IT components used in deployed customer products. Establish monitoring, patching, backup, secure remote access, operational readiness and clear support handovers.

  • Define and improve the IT responsibilities within manufacturing and test environments, including asset registration, operating systems, connectivity, support boundaries and a segregated OT network architecture.

  • Implement and operate the security controls assigned to IT, maintain evidence and remediation plans, and work with the Security Office on incidents, risks and exceptions.

  • Work with R&D and Data Science on agreed infrastructure and integrations. Those teams retain ownership of DevOps and MLOps.

  • Plan and deliver IT services for new locations, including remote support, local hands, equipment logistics and coordination with Security and Facilities.

  • Own the IT budget and supplier relationships, and ensure that external partners complement internal accountability and knowledge.

  • Lead the disentanglement of interconnected IT services and dependencies, establishing clear ownership while protecting continuity and ensuring controlled handovers.

  • Use service performance, workload, risks and skills data to guide recruitment, training and investment, and communicate progress clearly to management.

What we offer

  • The opportunity to shape and scale the IT organisation of an international deep-tech company.

  • Meaningful responsibility for the team, services, architecture and investments within your remit.

  • A competitive salary and benefits package.

  • An international working environment with colleagues from more than twenty nationalities.

  • Regular team activities, company events and fresh team lunches three times per week.


What you bring

We care more about what you can do than how you got there. We welcome strong candidates from different educational and career backgrounds.

  • You have led an IT function or multidisciplinary technical team through growth and understand how to build capacity before services become overstretched.

  • You have managed specialists across infrastructure, applications and end-user support and know how to create clear ownership without losing collaboration.

  • You lead through coaching, practical support and honest feedback, and you invest in your team's professional development.

  • You are comfortable across a modern hybrid environment, including Microsoft 365, Azure and Entra ID, on-premises infrastructure, networking, endpoint management, backup and recovery.

  • You do not need to be the deepest expert in every domain, but you can challenge designs, ask the right questions and make credible technical decisions.

  • You have practical experience with IT service management, enterprise applications, integrations, architecture and technology roadmaps.

  • You have owned budgets and supplier relationships and can make clear trade-offs between service, risk, cost and capacity.

  • You have worked in, or can quickly adapt to, an environment where security, compliance and defence obligations shape how IT operates.

  • You communicate clearly in English with technical teams, business owners and senior management. Dutch is an advantage.

  • Nice to have

  • Experience with manufacturing IT, operational technology or segregated production networks.

  • Experience with operational IT services used in customer products or customer environments.

  • ITIL 4 or enterprise architecture training, supported by practical experience.

  • Experience with international office rollouts, tenant separation or organisational carve-outs.

Security and compliance

You will work with clients in the defence and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements. More information you can find by: https://english.aivd.nl/topics/s/security-screening

Ready to join us

If you are excited to lead and grow the IT function of an ambitious technology company, we would like to hear from you. Apply through our careers page.

Optics11 is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees.
