data.title: Research Engineer (Materials Foundation Models)
data.description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

To scale our scientific intelligence and data curation capabilities, we are looking for three Research Engineers* to train and evaluate the foundation models behind our materials discovery platform: representation learning over crystal structures and properties, LLM fine-tuning and post-training for scientific tasks, and the evaluation and data work that makes those models useful. You will work in a small team where each person owns a model end to end, from data and experiment design through training at scale to integration.

*Note that you would be joining as a ‘Member of Technical Staff’, but the job title above hopefully helps to explain the nature of this role.



Your Impact

You will be responsible for building and training specialised foundation models on terabytes of scientific data at massive scale, fundamentally enhancing our platform's multi-modal capabilities.

The modalities span crystal structures, properties, text and images. Depending on your background you may lead on self-supervised representation learning, LLM fine-tuning and post-training (SFT, RL), or the evaluation suites that decide between them.

What You Will Do


Research and Model Training at Scale

  • Design and run experiments: scaling studies, ablations and evaluations that settle which modelling choices survive.

  • Lead efforts in parallel training of multi-modal foundation models at scale (e.g. orchestrating parallel training across hundreds of GPUs and handling data in the order of Terabytes).

  • Apply strong software engineering best practices to ensure the systems are scalable, reliable, and maintainable.

  • Own the data curation and evaluation design for your models; these outlast the modelling decisions.

Scientific Collaboration & Integration

  • Partner closely with our Chemists and Materials Scientists to integrate computational and experimental workflows into one seamless optimisation loop.

  • Be proactive in learning the technical vocabulary of materials science and experimental chemistry to facilitate meaningful interactions with domain experts.

  • Contribute to our mission by ensuring all system designs align with CuspAI's commitment to sustainability and world-changing challenges.


Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You are someone who gets excited about the opportunity to enable scientists to work on world changing challenges in this domain, with a personal interest in the potential applications of the technology that CuspAI is building.

  • Strong software engineering skills and a proven track record of building complex, high-performance systems at scale in a production or industrial environment.

  • Hands-on experience training or evaluating large models in a distributed setting. For senior candidates this means having led a multi-hundred-GPU training effort; for earlier-career candidates, having been a core contributor to one.

  • Depth in at least one of: large-scale vision or representation learning, LLM pre-training or post-training, reinforcement learning. We care more about one substantial, scale-y project than about breadth.

  • A deep interest in the connection between AI and materials science or chemistry, and a willingness to rapidly learn the scientific vocabulary of the discipline.

  • Master’s or PhD in CS, ML or a related quantitative field, or equivalent experience. We are hiring across levels: from strong early-career research engineers (typically 1 to 3 years at a frontier lab or equivalent) to senior and staff engineers who have led model programmes.

  • Experience with representation learning and computer vision, e.g. self-supervised or contrastive pre-training, learning embeddings, or building models that pull structured information out of images such as figures, plots and diagrams.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • RL for post-training (RLHF, GRPO-style methods) or RL in agentic settings.

  • Experience at a frontier lab or a team that ships models at scale.

  • Prior experience applying machine learning models specifically to problems in materials science, chemistry, or molecular informatics.

  • Exposure to multi-modal training (e.g. text, vision, etc.) and how to combine modalities in a meaningful way.


Additional Considerations

This role could be based in our Cambridge, London, Amsterdam or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to our other offices for collaboration and project oversight.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

Who are we?

Smarkets: Predicting the Future of Betting

Smarkets runs one of the world’s most sophisticated prediction markets, handling over £29 billion in volume since 2010 and engaging 200,000+ traders globally. Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ Why we are hiring ⭐️

We’re opening an Enterprise Sales Team Lead role in France to lead a growing team of 4 Senior Account Executives, who are in charge of acquiring customers with more than 3,000 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

In this role, you will own acquisition on the Enterprise segment in France and run the business end‑to‑end: you will be hands-on on the field while coaching and scaling a team of Account Executives to win this market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition: We have just passed the one million member milestone – and this is only the beginning! We’re accelerating acquisition in France and doubling down on our portfolio — and the Enterprise segment is one of the core pillars of that plan.

About the Enterprise segment

  • Perimeter: companies of 3000+ employees

  • Verticals: all Verticals (Tech, Retail, Industrial Companies etc)

  • Total Addressable Market: ~7M members in France

Why Enterprise Sales is exciting at Alan

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers, Unions, long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise Account Executives.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

⭐ What you will do ⭐

You will be the Sales leader of the Enterprise Sales team in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and scaling the machine.

More precisely, you will:

  • Own the Enterprise acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go‑to‑market strategy for 3000 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets and scale the segment.

  • Lead & coach a team of 4 Account Executives (and likely more to come)

    • Drive hiring, onboarding, and career development as we scale the crew and the segment.

    • Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations, rigorous follow‑up, and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution, and pipeline management.

    • Be on the field with the team: prospecting, joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

  • Empower every member of the team: Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: strong feedback culture, coaching, clear ownership, and autonomy.

data.description:
The Role

Intellect delivers a clinically governed mental health programme to enterprise clients in the mining and resources sector, supporting remote and expatriate workforces. This is not a standard EAP. Cases begin with acute risk assessment on remote sites and run through structured treatment, fitness-for-work assessment and return-to-work clearance, in direct coordination with the client's chaplaincy, medical and people teams.

This role covers the client's United Kingdom operations and a West African project site where the working language is French. It is a combined clinical delivery and case management role: the postholder conducts the assessments, delivers the therapy, writes the reports and owns the case, rather than coordinating a provider network. That design reflects the absence of an established provider network in the West African market at launch, and gives the client a single clinician who knows each case end to end.

Full professional fluency in French and English is a non-negotiable requirement. Welfare calls, clinical assessment, case documentation and client communication in the West African market are conducted in French.

Responsibilities

Clinical assessment and delivery

  • Conduct acute risk and welfare assessments for employees referred through the client's escalation pathway, in French or English as required.
  • Deliver individual counselling and psychotherapy across the supported caseload, virtually.
  • Conduct fitness-for-work assessments and produce the associated clinical documentation.
  • Write risk assessments, session documentation, return-to-work memoranda and fitness-for-work reports to a standard that stands up to client and regulatory scrutiny, in the language the case requires.
  • Delivery is capped so that case management availability is protected. Session load is agreed with the Head of Clinical Operations and reviewed as volume changes.

Case management and coordination

  • Own each case end to end, from referral through assessment, treatment, fitness-for-work and reintegration to closure.
  • Align the initial support plan with the client's on-site teams, including session volume and cadence, and manage adjustments where clinically indicated.
  • Coordinate with internal helpline, care excellence and network partnership teams on anything that cannot be delivered directly.
  • Review the open case list for stalled items and follow up to keep cases moving.

Clinical risk oversight and governance

  • Confirm risk tiering against the client's framework and set review cadence and monitoring requirements.
  • Make the clinical decisions the pathway requires, including disputed risk ratings and medical evaluation pathways where an employee declines therapy.
  • Escalate to the Head of Clinical Operations where a case exceeds the scope of remote delivery or requires in-person intervention.
  • Work within the differing regulatory, medical and emergency-escalation environments of each market, and flag where local pathways do not support the agreed protocol.

Clinical protocols and client enablement

  • Co-develop and maintain the clinical protocols, risk frameworks and SOPs the client's on-site teams operate to, including French-language versions.
  • Design and deliver clinical training and framework guidance to client-side staff who are not clinicians, in French and English.
  • Build out the in-market provider network alongside Network Partnerships, so that in-person and overflow capacity exists as the programme scales.

Client relationship, insights and reporting

  • Act as the named clinical contact for the client's chaplaincy, medical and health and safety leads in both markets, responding within the core window to queries that are frequently unscheduled and time-critical.
  • Produce the case tracker and monthly clinical reporting, moving beyond utilisation to presenting issues, risk patterns, outcomes and service-level themes.
  • Present clinical insight at client review meetings and translate it into recommendations the client's health and safety and people teams can act on.

Requirements

  • Full professional fluency in French and English, to the standard required for clinical assessment, therapy delivery and client-facing documentation in both languages.
  • Registered clinical psychologist or qualified counsellor, with current registration in your jurisdiction and the right to practise remotely.
  • Master's degree in clinical psychology, counselling or a related field.
  • Minimum three years in clinical practice, including direct delivery of assessment and therapy to adults.
  • Demonstrable experience managing acute risk, including suicidality, in a setting where you held the decision rather than advised on it.
  • Experience of structured return-to-work, fitness-for-work or occupational mental health pathways.
  • Able to work four hours a day, Monday to Friday, within the 08:00 to 17:00 UK and West Africa window.

Desirable

  • Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or with expatriate, rotational or multinational workforces.
  • Understanding of remote industrial, mining, resources or energy operating environments.
  • Additional language capability, particularly Mandarin.
  • Experience contributing to clinical protocols, risk frameworks or SOPs.
  • Prior case management or clinical account experience in a commercial setting.

data.description:
Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Envie d’imaginer la suite de cette histoire à nos côtés ? Ecrivez-nous !


Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Retail Merchandiser Europe en CDD à partir de maintenant, pour une durée de 6 mois minimum (H/F) pour rejoindre nos équipes. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75).

Intégré(e) au sein du pôle Merchandising, rattaché(e) à la Responsable Retail Merchandising Europe vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

  • Création des assortiments pour nos projets spéciaux 2027 (pop-up, takeover grands magasins, rénovations, événements presse/influence): préparation des ouvertures et suivi hebdomadaire pour s'adapter au trend et aux besoins clients, en lien étroit avec les départements architecture, visuel merchandising et supply chain.
  • Coordination des sélections produits pour nos braderies et projets archives, en lien avec les équipes supply chain et visuel merchandising;
  • Réalisation d'analyses ad-hoc sur la performance de l’offre pour mettre en place des plans d’action concrets à court ou moyen terme ;
  • Interaction avec les points de vente de manière hebdomadaire pour les demandes d’ajustement de l’assortiment (demandes d’ajout, de retour…) ;
  • Participation aux visites de points de vente (floor et stock) afin de mettre en place des plans d’action visant à optimiser la satisfaction client ;
  • Support aux ouvertures des pops ups et projets spéciaux, via une présence terrain pour accompagner les équipes retail.

Requirements

  • Diplômé(e) d'une école de mode ou d’une école de commerce avec spécialisation mode, ou de son équivalent universitaire ;
  • Vous mettez en avant une expérience de minimum 3 ans sur un poste équivalent au sein d'une marque de prêt-à-porter ;
  • Vous disposez d’une forte sensibilité produit combinée à un œil business pragmatique ;
  • Vous êtes curieux(euse), proactif(ive) avec un sens entrepreneurial ;
  • Vous maitrisez Excel, et avez un goût prononcé pour l’analyse de données, vous savez vous appuyer sur l'IA pour gagner du temps ;
  • Vous êtes très organisé(e) et la gestion des priorités n'a pas de secret pour vous !
  • Anglais courant indispensable.


Vous vous êtes reconnu(e) dans ce descriptif et souhaitez rejoindre l’aventure Sézane ? Alors n’attendez plus !

data.title: Deployment Strategist - Crypto Investigations
data.description:
Global Services helps Chainalysis customers turn blockchain data and investigative tools into practical results. Our customers include law enforcement, national security teams, financial institutions, and organisations across the crypto industry.

We’re looking for a Deployment Strategist, Crypto Investigations, to join Global Services and support public-sector customers in France, particularly law enforcement and intelligence teams. You’ll use your investigative experience and technical skills to help customers get the most out of Chainalysis products. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role focused on investigations and practical problem-solving rather than software engineering.

You’ll work with customers throughout their engagement with Chainalysis, from understanding their needs and conducting investigations to developing workflows, delivering training, and helping them build their own capabilities. You’ll need sound investigative judgement, strong French communication skills, and the ability to build trusted relationships with customers.


In this role, you’ll:

  • Support customer engagements from initial discovery and pre-sales through investigations, solution delivery, training, and ongoing support

  • Conduct blockchain investigations using Chainalysis products, particularly Reactor

  • Work with law enforcement, intelligence, and other public-sector customers to understand their objectives and help them achieve practical results

  • Build and adapt investigative workflows, queries, reports, and dashboards using Chainalysis tools and data

  • Help customers put investigative workflows into practice and develop the skills to use Chainalysis independently

  • Build trusted customer relationships by providing practical investigative guidance and product expertise

  • Lead customer meetings, demonstrations, investigative walkthroughs, training sessions, and technical briefings

  • Support pre-sales discussions by understanding customer requirements and explaining how Chainalysis can help

  • Share customer feedback and investigative insights with Product, Engineering, Global Intel, and Sales

  • Share investigative techniques and best practices with colleagues across Global Services

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Experience conducting or supporting investigations in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, or a related field. Candidates with relevant crypto or financial-crime investigation experience from other backgrounds will also be considered

  • Experience working with public-sector, law-enforcement, intelligence, or other mission-focused stakeholders

  • Strong investigative judgement and the ability to explain findings clearly and build credibility with customers

  • The technical aptitude to learn investigative platforms and work with data; extensive software-engineering experience is not required

  • The ability to analyse complex information and communicate findings to both investigators and senior stakeholders

  • The flexibility to work across pre-sales, customer delivery, and ongoing support

  • Fluency in French, with the ability to work confidently with French-speaking customers

  • The ability to be based in France, ideally in Paris

Required Skills

Technical Skills

  • Confidence using investigative tools and the ability to develop expertise in Chainalysis Reactor

  • Ability to work with investigative data and turn customer requirements into practical workflows, queries, and reports

  • Familiarity with blockchain investigation tools or analytical workflows is an advantage; Python and SQL are not required

  • Ability to learn Chainalysis products and understand how their data can support customer investigations

Domain Expertise

  • Experience in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, financial crime, or another relevant investigative field

  • Understanding of investigative objectives, operational workflows, and the outcomes customers need to achieve

  • Ability to use investigative judgement to guide an investigation and advise customers on their approach

Customer & Communication Skills

  • Ability to build trusted customer relationships through investigative knowledge and practical support

  • Excellent spoken and written French, including the ability to explain complex investigative concepts clearly

  • Confidence leading customer meetings, briefings, demonstrations, and training sessions

  • Ability to help customers develop their own skills and use Chainalysis tools independently

Day to Day Activities

  • Conduct investigations using Chainalysis tools, primarily Reactor, based on customer requirements

  • Prepare investigative reports, workflows, queries, and other analytical outputs

  • Work directly with customers to develop and implement investigative workflows

  • Deliver hands-on training, walkthroughs, and knowledge-sharing sessions

  • Lead demonstrations, investigative briefings, and solution presentations

  • Support pre-sales discussions, technical discovery, and solution scoping

  • Gather customer feedback and share practical recommendations with Product, Engineering, and Global Intel

  • Manage multiple customer engagements while maintaining quality and responsiveness

  • Continue developing knowledge of blockchain investigations and emerging crypto-related threats

Personal Attributes

  • Curious about blockchain technology, crypto crime, and investigative techniques

  • Able to communicate clearly and adapt to different audiences

  • Comfortable taking ownership and making sound decisions in situations where the path forward may not be clear

  • Collaborative and willing to work across teams

  • Keen to develop specialist knowledge and share it with others

Nice to have experience: [icing on the cake, not a deal breaker]

  • Previous experience using Chainalysis products

  • Experience with cryptocurrency investigations, blockchain analytics, or financial-crime analysis

  • Experience in traditional finance or financial investigations

  • Experience providing expert evidence or supporting legal proceedings

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as BSA/AML, sanctions screening, MiCA, or the Travel Rule

  • Experience with data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or cloud-based analytics tools

  • Published research, intelligence reports, or other work relating to blockchain analytics or financial crime

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you. 

Compensation: €130K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

Business Development Manager (AI Data Solutions)
data.description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? This role

will focus on developing new business relationships and act as a strategic customer partner within the AI Solutions group (DataForce). DataForce is a rapidly growing service offering high quality data for Human Machine Interaction to some of the most prestigious technology companies in the world. Our department focuses on gathering, enriching and processing training data for Machine Learning in different AI domains.

DataForce is part of the TransPerfect family of companies, the world’s largest provider of language and technology solutions for global business with offices in more than 100 cities worldwide and we are recruiting globally.

Key position responsibilities:

• Identify potential clients in the target market and complete appropriate research on the prospective client’s business and technical needs

• Identify, qualify and quantify opportunities

• Drive opportunities from lead generation all the way to closure

• Ensure customer success and satisfaction

• Draft and implement business plans

• Understand client’s business and technical requirements

• Become a subject matter expert on our business products, processes and operations, and remain up-to-date on industry news

• Keep track of business opportunities on TransPerfect’s CRM system

• Coordinate production and technology teams across different time zones and cultures

• Generate and manage high-value profitable business deals

• Identify, track and manage KPIs and provide internal and client facing status reports; providing of executive updates including account progress, health, risk and opportunities

• Attend tradeshows and support marketing efforts by contributing to case studies and social media

• Provide accurate weekly forecasts and daily update reports

• Assist in building overall plans/budgets and subsequent adherence; own the overall financial health of assigned client engagements; drive efficiencies across process, people and technology

• Manage stakeholder communication around owned business and accounts

• Assist in training and adoption of technologies and services for internal and client teams

• Propose and implement new innovative offerings


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Essential experience required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

  • Minimum 3 years successful sales experience

  • Superior communication skills

  • Proven track record in achieving sales target within the AI industry

TransPerfect values equal opportunities. Applicants are therefore considered regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnic origin, skin colour, religion, belief, descent, genes, disabilities, sexual orientation, marital status or other characteristics worthy of protection. Applicants with disabilities are welcome and encouraged. Are you interested in helping international brands/organizations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect was founded with a mission to help the world's businesses navigate the global marketplace. Today, we have grown to be an industry leader organization by helping clients globalize their business no matter what service they might need. TransPerfect provides a full array of language and business support services, including translation, subtitling and dubbing, multicultural marketing, website globalization, legal support, and any kind of technology solution.

That’s enough about us – what about you? We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.

TransPerfect is looking for established sales professionals to further develop our engagement model. The Director of Business Development will be responsible for identifying and engaging with client prospects as well as managing client relationships during the full life cycle of client campaigns. data.title: Sterling Account Executive
data.description:
Sterling Technology, a subsidiary of TransPerfect, is the leading provider of premium virtual data room (VDR) solutions for the secure sharing of content, business process automation, and collaboration for the M&A, corporate development, real estate, capital markets, private capital, banking, and legal communities. Sterling has been supporting the M&A and capital markets for over 30 years, initially with financial printing services. Since opening our first VDR in 2010, we have helped customers from over 187 countries and 90 industries successfully complete thousands of deals. With offices in seven major financial centres, Sterling is trusted by its users to deliver exceptional levels of service on their most critical transactions.

 

Sterling is a fast-growing B2B SaaS technology business. We have recently been acquired by TransPerfect, the world’s largest provider of language and technology solutions for global business, with offices in over 120 cities on six continents.

Summary:

The main focus of the role is to enhance clients' relationships and develop new accounts within different industries.

Your responsibilities and tasks will include:

  • Create effective approaches to drive new revenue and close new business

  • Identify, qualify, develop, and close sales opportunities

  • Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of Sterling’s services

  • Identify prospective leads; develop new client relationships via cold calling, internet research, networking events, and direct marketing

  • Promote Sterling by educating clients on the company’s various services

  • Present Sterling via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings

  • Provide customer support and manage client expectations

  • Quote, manage, and bill projects daily, coordinating with clients and production teams to ensure these run smoothly and profitably

  • Communicate professionally at all levels of seniority

  • Based out of Paris, with travel required within France as needed

Sounds like a match? We look forward to meeting you!

  •  Experience and/or interest in the M&A space

  •  Proven track record in sales or a client-facing role

  •  Ability to build and maintain long-term client relationships

  •  Strong presentation skills (both in-person and online)

  •  Excellent written and verbal communication in English and French

  •  Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities

  •  Highly organised with strong attention to detail

  •  Able to prioritise, manage tasks, and work effectively in a team

Preferred experience:

  • Experience in a B2B sales/business development role

data.title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
data.description:
TopChrono, leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

 

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

  • Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

  • Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

  • Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact !

 

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes :

Rattachement hiérarchique

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

 

Mission principale

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

 

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

 

Étude et déploiement des matériels

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

 

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

 

Gestion des fournisseurs

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

 

Qualité et amélioration continue

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

 

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à :

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

 

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES

En interne

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.

 


PROFIL RECHERCHE

Formation

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles

• Sens de l'organisation.

• Rigueur et méthode.

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.

• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.

Objectifs du poste

• Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules.

• Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique.

• Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température.

• Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport.

• Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié

data.title: Solutions Engineer - French Speaker
data.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

We’re hiring Solutions Engineers to build Synthesia’s presales function in France and Southern EMEA. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model. If you’re someone who is excited by building whilst scaling, we’d love to hear from you.

As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product.

This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across France and Southern EMEA.

Sales Cycle Ownership & AE Partnership

  • Co-plan and support discovery calls with your AE to understand customer requirements, technical environment, and business challenges.

  • Deliver demonstrations that speak to customer problems and tell a credible story of why Synthesia is the right solution.

  • Identify technical objections and integration questions as they come up, working with your AE and the broader ecosystem to find a path forward.

  • Contribute your assessment of technical fit and opportunity risk to help your AE shape account and deal strategy.

  • Keep your deal team and manager informed on deal status, timeline, and technical dependencies.

Demo Excellence

  • Design and execute repeatable demo methodologies that prove Synthesia's business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, building Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product.

  • Identify, build relationships with, and actively enable technical champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally.

  • Develop and maintain reusable assets across demo environments, use cases, integration templates, objection handling, and industry playbooks, brought to life directly in Synthesia's platform.

  • Provide technical guidance on platform capabilities, API and SDK integrations, security, compliance topics (SOC 2, GDPR, enterprise identity), and scalability for global deployments, troubleshooting issues and validating integrations with LMS, HCM, and content systems as they surface.

Product Expertise

  • Build and maintain strong working knowledge of Synthesia's platform capabilities, roadmap, and positioning across all product lines, so you can speak to the use cases that drive value.

  • Partner with Enablement to complete certifications, stay current on new releases, and keep your demo and objection-handling skills sharp.

  • Stay ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development.

Ecosystem Collaboration

  • Product: share customer and prospect feedback with Product, flagging pain points, missing capabilities, and gaps that surface in your deals to help shape the roadmap.

  • Product Marketing: work with Product Marketing to understand and apply messaging and positioning in your deal cycles, and contribute to reusable assets like demo scripts and competitive battlecards.

  • Customer Success: brief Customer Success on technical context and champion relationships at handover, so your POCs and pilots convert cleanly into production deployments.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical experience in a SaaS environment (or equivalent technical customer-facing experience).

  • Delivers a strong standard demo aligned to the discovery points and agenda set with the AE, with a solid grasp of core demo technique (e.g., Tell-Show-Tell).

  • Applies established solution designs and best practices to the customer's use case, working with core ecosystem functions (Product, Customer Success) as the deal requires.

  • Identifies and surfaces deal risk and next steps based on what the customer tells you, escalating clearly to your AE so it gets actioned.

  • Working knowledge of MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, and can articulate why Synthesia is a fit for the prospect.

  • Resourceful: knows how to find the right person or tool internally, and is building their own network across the GTM organization.

  • Comfortable with the technical fundamentals in at least one area (creation flows, APIs, integrations, security, compliance) and eager to build depth quickly.

  • Self-motivated and organized, able to manage a growing book of POCs, demos, and customer conversations while hitting deadlines.

  • Willing to travel for customer discovery and on-site demos as needed.

We'd be particularly excited if

  • You speak Spanish and Italian

Location

We’re ideally looking for someone based in Paris who can spend time in our office at 40 Rue du Colisée, 75008 Paris, or someone based in the UK who can spend time in our London office at 20 Triton Street, Regent’s Place, London NW1 3BF. Please confirm where you are located and whether you can spend two days a week in either location.

This role is ideal for someone organized, proactive, and detail-oriented, passionate about building experiences that connect people, ideas, and innovation in a fast-paced tech environment.

Competitive Pay

An Exceptional Team

Our compact teams work with autonomy and focus — every contribution matters, and every project shapes the future of legal AI.

Growth that Matters

This role gives you exposure to both internal and external event operations, cross-functional collaboration, and brand activation.

You’ll develop real-world skills and a mindset for excellence in execution.

Rewarding Your Contribution

Vos missions

  • Diriger et développer une équipe de consultants commerciaux terrain indépendants, en construisant les compétences et la culture nécessaires pour s'imposer sur le marché

Notre engagement envers les petites entreprises se reflète dans notre équipe diversifiée de plus de 4 000 SumUppers originaires de plus de 90 nationalités, unis par une collaboration mondiale et un esprit innovant. You will work on the intersection of large-scale foundation models and real-world robotic execution, bridging the gap between state-of-the-art research and deployed embodied intelligence.

data.description:

Für den weiteren Ausbau unseres Oviva-ErnährungsberaterInnen-Netzwerks suchen wir dich per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung als ambulante Remote Ernährungsberater*in BSc 50-100% (a).

Warum Oviva?

Bei Oviva verfolgen wir eine klare Mission: Wir wollen eine nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich machen.

Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen mit gewichtsbedingten Erkrankungen. Für viele ist Gewichtsverlust ein Ziel, doch unser Ansatz geht weit darüber hinaus: Wir helfen, die Gesundheit zu verbessern, Selbstvertrauen aufzubauen und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Wir haben bereits über eine Million Menschen in der Schweiz, Deutschland, Polen und Grossbritannien unterstützt – und wir stehen erst am Anfang. Jedes Gespräch, jedes Coaching und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte diese Zukunft aktiv mit.


Die Rolle

Als Remote Ernährungsberater*in BSc (a) bietest du qualitativ hochwertige, digitale Ernährungsberatung für Patientinnen und Patienten im Rahmen unseres integrierten Gesundheit Ökosystems an. In dieser Rolle arbeitest du zu 100 % im Homeoffice. Du konzentrierst dich voll und ganz auf die direkte, virtuelle Betreuung sowie den engen interdisziplinären Austausch mit unserem medizinischen Fachpersonal (Ärztinnen und Ärzte, Psychotherapeut/-innen sowie Medizinische Praxisassistent/-innen).

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

  • Virtuelle Patientenbetreuung: Durchführung von ambulanter Ernährungsberatung im 100%igen Remote-Setting sowie selbstständige und effiziente Gestaltung deines digitalen Kalenders.

  • Pflege der Behandlungsdossiers: Sorgfältige und zeitnahe Dokumentation aller Therapieverläufe über unsere Plattformen (u. a. OCS und Tomedo).

  • Pfadkonforme Therapie: Konsequente Umsetzung unserer definierten Versorgungs- und Behandlungspfade (Oviva Clinic CH Dietetics Pathway).

  • Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit: Aktive Teilnahme an regelmässigen Fallbesprechungen und Rapporten mit Ärztinnen, Ärzten, Psychotherapeut/-innen und MPAs zur Sicherung einer ganzheitlichen Patientenversorgung.

  • Qualität & Entwicklung: Regelmässiger Austausch mit deiner Teamleitung sowie Teilnahme an virtuellen Teammeetings und internen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.

Das bringst du mit

  • Qualifikation: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Ernährungswissenschaften / Ernährungsberatung (FH oder Bachelor BFH / FFHS) oder eine entsprechende Schweizer SRK-Anerkennung eines ausländischen Diploms.

  • Bewilligung: Eine gültige Berufsausübungsbewilligung (BAB) für deinen Wohnkanton ab dem ersten Arbeitstag.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Muttersprachliche oder fliessende Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch, Französisch oder Italienisch; solide Arbeitskenntnisse in Englisch sind von Vorteil.

  • Digitale Affinität: Begeisterung für das Arbeiten im 100%igen Remote-Setting und Erfahrung mit digitaler Videokommunikation sowie der parallelen Nutzung verschiedener Software-Systeme.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Freude am täglichen, vertrauensvollen Austausch mit Patientinnen und Patienten sowie im interdisziplinären Team.

Was von Vorteil ist:

  • Erfahrung in der Beratung von Patientinnen und Patienten mit Adipositas und gewichtsbezogenen Erkrankungen (inkl. moderner Therapieformen wie GLP-1-Medikamenten).

  • Zusatzausbildung oder fundiertes Verständnis im Bereich Ernährungspsychologie.

  • Erfahrung in der digital unterstützten Gesundheitsversorgung (Digital Health).

Deine Benefits bei Oviva

  • Ein interessantes und abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet mit gezielter Einarbeitung in einem innovativem Geschäftsumfeld (Digital Health)

  • Ein unbefristete Festanstellung mit viel Flexibilität bezüglich Arbeitszeit, -pensum und -ort sowie Möglichkeit im Home Office zu arbeiten

  • Ein dynamisches, aufgeschlossenes und humorvolles Team, welches gemeinsam Erfolge feiert und Wissen untereinander teilt

  • Eine innovative, eigenentwickelte Software zur Datenverwaltung und Dokumentation sowie Kommunikation mit deinen Patienten

  • Attraktive Benefits wie ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget, Kauf von zusätzlichen Ferientagen sowie fortschrittliche Konditionen bei der beruflichen Vorsorge

(a) = alle: Vielfalt ist uns wichtig.

Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen:
Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich.

Oviva engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiter*innen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein wirklich inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.

Anstellung: Festanstellung mit viel Freiheiten und Selbstbestimmung

Pensum: 40-100%
Start: Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Du willst nicht einfach nur behandeln, sondern etwas bewegen?
Dann bist Du bei Oviva genau richtig.

Warum Oviva?

Bei Oviva verfolgen wir eine klare Mission: Wir wollen nachhaltige, personalisierte, klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich machen.

Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen mit gewichtsbedingten Erkrankungen. Für viele ist Gewichtsverlust ein Ziel, doch unser Ansatz geht weit darüber hinaus: Wir helfen, die Gesundheit zu verbessern, Selbstvertrauen aufzubauen und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Die Stelle

Ein breites therapeutisches Spektrum mit Tiefgang

Menschen mit Adipositas sind vielfältig – ebenso wie ihre Geschichten. Viele unserer Patient*innen leiden zusätzlich unter psychischen oder neurodivergenten Herausforderungen wie ADHS, Autismus-Spektrum-Themen, Burnout, Depression, Angststörungen oder Binge-Eating-Störungen.
Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen eine ganzheitliche, respektvolle und wirksame therapeutische Begleitung zu bieten – jenseits von Stigmatisierung und oberflächlichen Ansätzen.

Bei Oviva greifen wir Themen auf, die viele unserer Patient*innen beschäftigen – wie Selbstbild, hormonelle Veränderungen, Elternschaft, Belastung im Alltag oder emotionale Essmuster. In der Psychotherapie bei Oviva dürfen all diese Themen ihren Platz haben.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst Psychotherapien in unserer Praxis und online via Video-Sessions durch.

data.title: DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

As a DevOps Engineer at Namespace, you'll build and operate the infrastructure that makes this performance possible. You'll own the compute, storage, and networking behind every build our customers run, keeping the platform fast, reliable, and cost-effective as we accelerate more companies around the world.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of the infrastructure that runs every customer’s build, test, and CI job on Namespace.

  • Optimize performance across compute, memory, storage, and networking.

  • Automate provisioning, deployment, scaling, and recovery across our fleet.

  • Build observability, alerting, and incident response processes that identify and resolve issues before they affect customers.

  • Drive capacity planning and cost efficiency, so we continue to deliver infrastructure that is both faster and more cost-effective.

  • Collaborate closely with product engineers to ship new capabilities quickly and safely.

What we're looking for

  • Strong engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience operating production infrastructure at scale.

  • Deep knowledge of Linux, networking, and storage, plus experience with tools like Kubernetes, Terraform, or similar.

  • Proficiency in Go, Python, or a similar language, automation is paramount.

  • Deep experience with observability tooling and participating in on-call rotations.

  • A strong focus on performance and a rigorous approach to measuring and improving it.

  • Bonus: experience with bare metal, virtualization (KVM, Firecracker), or running CI/CD systems at scale.

You can expect:

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Flexible working hours

  • Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs:

  • We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

  • We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

  • We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

data.title: Embedded Engineer
data.description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Embedded Engineer, you will own the firmware that runs on that hardware, from the first register write to the moment data leaves the device, so that what reaches our ML team is clean, synchronized, and trustworthy.

What You Will Do

  • Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots.

  • Build real-time data acquisition: drivers, DMA, buffering, and streaming from many sensors at once without dropping a sample.

  • Solve multi-sensor synchronization, calibration, and time-stamping so every data point lines up across devices and modalities.

  • Bring up new boards with our Electrical Engineer and turn fresh hardware into working devices fast.

  • Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your firmware decides what their training data looks like, and a timing bug can quietly ruin months of data.

  • Make firmware reliable in the field: testing, OTA updates, error handling, and diagnostics that tell us what went wrong.

Requirements

  • Up to 5 years writing production firmware for embedded or IoT systems.

  • Strong C/C++, experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), and deep familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar).

  • Hands-on experience with peripheral interfaces and protocols: SPI, I2C, UART, USB, BLE, CAN, or similar.

  • Experience integrating sensors in firmware: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar.

  • A strong understanding of how firmware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: ADC configuration, sample rate, jitter, filtering, and buffering. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you write code accordingly.

  • Comfortable debugging at the hardware boundary with a logic analyzer, oscilloscope, and debugger.

  • Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. You are comfortable in 0-to-1 ambiguity, where the spec is "figure out what the spec should be".

  • Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

  • Fluent in English. German is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • A background in robotics, motion capture, or wearable devices.

  • Experience with real-time or hard-deadline systems: audio, video sync, or robotic control loops.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, time-sync protocols (PTP or similar), or low-power design.

  • Familiarity with ML training pipelines. Even if you don't run them, you can read a training script.

  • Open-source firmware contributions.

  • Experience taking firmware from prototype to small-batch production: test fixtures, provisioning, and certification support.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

This is not for you if:

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

data.title: Design Release Engineer -Airframe
data.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Design Release Manager to join our Airframe Team in Lausanne. In this role, you will bridge the gap between initial mechanical concept and full-scale manufacturing, taking complete ownership of the manufacturing dossier for our composite structures and airframe modules.

From day one, you will drive Design for Manufacturability and Design for Assembly directly inside the design loop, before parts are frozen. You will set and hold the release standard, define geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, manage engineering change orders, and act as the single authority signing off on product transfer gates to manufacturing.

What You Will Do

  • Manufacturing Dossier Ownership: Own and maintain the complete transfer package for your designated airframe module, including controlled drawing packages, bill of materials structures, material and finish specifications, critical characteristics, and acceptance criteria.

  • Design Loop Integration: Collaborate directly with mechanical design engineers early in the design phase to optimize composite layups, bonded joints, tooling interfaces, and tolerance stack-ups while design changes are still fast and low cost.

  • Transfer Gate & Release Authority: Serve as the final authority on product release packages, evaluating transfer readiness against gate standards before handing hardware over to manufacturing operations.

  • Disposition & Configuration Management: Manage engineering change orders and serve as the single technical contact for drawing dispositions, non-conformance reviews, and design clarification requests from the production line.

  • Supplier & Manufacturing Alignment: Work closely with production operations and external suppliers to evaluate manufacturing constraints for composite structures and precision assemblies.

  • Feedback & Continuous Improvement: Analyze initial production build data and floor feedback to refine manufacturing dossiers and update gate standards for future design iterations.

What We Are Looking For

  • Background: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline.

  • Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerance Analysis: Practical mastery of applying GD&T with intent, performing tolerance stack-up analyses, and defining clear acceptance criteria.

  • Composite Structures & Manufacturing: Strong working knowledge of composite materials, layup sequences, tooling limitations, cure cycles, and bonded structural joints.

  • Drawing & Package Control: Proven experience owning released drawing packages, managing structured bill of materials, and running engineering change order workflows.

  • Early Stage Execution: Demonstrated success integrating manufacturing and assembly principles directly into active design reviews rather than conducting post-design audits.

  • Language Skills: Professional proficiency in both English and French to work fluidly across design engineering and French-speaking production teams.

What We Offer

  • Direct ownership in defining the release and manufacturing transfer standards for high-performance defense airframes.

  • Active collaboration with design engineers early in the development cycle where engineering decisions carry high leverage.

  • High-visibility technical impact across fast-scaling, hardware-centric production programs.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

data.title: Characterization Lead
data.description:
At Kandou, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

As Characterization Lead, you will own performance characterization of Zinal retimer silicon and the Randa Active Electrical Cable (AEC) channel. This is a Principal / Senior Staff individual contributor role with hands-on technical leadership. Your measurements will establish datasheet limits, channel classes and guard-bands for validation, manufacturing and customer specifications. Based primarily in Lausanne, you will work with silicon, signal integrity and validation teams, including channel characterization partners in Taiwan.

Responsabilities

· Lead silicon and channel characterization from measurement planning and bench setup through analysis, limit derivation and documented hand-off to validation.

· Characterize TX/RX SerDes performance across process, voltage and temperature: swing, jitter, sensitivity, equalization, adaptation, CDR lock, BER bathtubs and shmoos.

· Own channel measurements to at least 50 GHz, including de-embedding, insertion/return loss, mixed-mode S-parameters and common-mode and mode-conversion behavior.

· Establish reference-paddle baselines and channel classes by gauge, reach and frequency; correlate HTDR-derived metrics with calibrated VNA measurements.

· Derive datasheet limits and guard-bands from measured distributions, accounting for uncertainty, sample coverage and aging; maintain traceable datasets and limit revisions.

· Assess carrier-loading and forwarded-clock tradeoffs using measured channel data and simulation, and translate the findings into supported configurations and characterization limits.

· Characterize power, energy per bit and thermal behavior across operating modes and corners; investigate equalizer noise amplification and channel/thermal interactions.

· Coordinate shared laboratory equipment and characterization milestones with validation teams; lead technical reviews and deliver limits in time for downstream qualification and screening.

Essential Experience

· 10 to 14 years of experience in SerDes/silicon characterization and/or high-speed channel and signal integrity characterization following degree completion.

· Direct ownership of a characterization program whose results became datasheet limits or qualification thresholds for a shipping product.

· Strong VNA measurement experience to 50 GHz or beyond, including de-embedding, mixed-mode S-parameters (Sdd/Scc/Scd/Sdc) and insertion/return-loss mask interpretation.

· Hands-on TX/RX SerDes characterization, jitter decomposition, BER bathtubs, PVT shmoos and equalization/adaptation analysis.

· Demonstrated common-mode and mode-conversion measurement depth, with the ability to distinguish channel behavior from fixture and calibration artifacts.

· Statistical characterization and guard-band derivation across corners, with clear treatment of measurement uncertainty, sample size and aging.

· Experience with VNAs, oscilloscopes of at least 50 GHz bandwidth, BERTs, jitter instrumentation, thermal forcing and ATE characterization load boards.

· BS in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with the technical communication and coordination skills to hand off defensible limits to validation and manufacturing teams.

Essential Experience

· Characterization leadership for shipping 100G/lane or 200G/lane retimers, PHYs, AECs or AOCs.

· Deep mixed-mode characterization where common-mode behavior affects information transport and link margin.

· Experience producing datasheet limits that a separate validation team independently qualified.

· Multi-carrier or proprietary coding schemes, including OFDM-style subcarriers and space-time coding, and their characterization implications.

· Published work or patents in channel modeling, de-embedding or SerDes characterization.

· MS or PhD with a concentration in communications, RF/microwave engineering or signal integrity.
