data.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
data.description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly's operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

  • Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
  • Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
  • Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.
  • Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.
  • Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.
  • Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.
  • Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.
  • Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.

What we are looking for

  • Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.
  • Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.
  • Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.
  • Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.
  • Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.

Useful experience, but not required

  • DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.
  • Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.
  • GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.
  • Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.
  • Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations.
  • Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby.

What we offer you

At Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team.

  • Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives.
  • Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale.
  • Wellbeing support, paid holidays, family leave, and sustainable ways of working.
  • Equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.
  • A flexible hybrid workplace that balances office collaboration with focused remote work. At Smartly we work 3 days a week from the office.

About Smartly

Smartly is an advertising technology company helping brands create, manage, optimize, and understand digital advertising across major media platforms. Our engineering organization builds the systems that connect media, creative, and intelligence capabilities into a product used by customers globally.

We value clear communication, ownership, curiosity, and collaboration across teams. We want Smartly to be a place where people can do strong work, grow, and feel respected.

Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to build reliable systems with others. Direct experience with every technology listed here is less important than the judgment to learn, reason from first principles, and ship useful platform capabilities.

About Smartly

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.

Visit Smartly to learn more.

data.title: Finance Business Partner - Membership & Consumer Finance (m/w/d)
data.description:
Für ein wachstumsorientiertes Dienstleistungsunternehmen mit kundenbasierten, wiederkehrenden Geschäftsmodellen suchen wir einen Finance Business Partner (m/w/d). In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die kaufmännische Steuerung zentraler Geschäftsbereiche und sind geschätzter Sparringspartner für Management und Fachbereiche.

Aufgaben

  • Kaufmännische Begleitung der verantworteten Geschäftsbereiche sowie Beratung des Managements in steuerungsrelevanten Fragestellungen (Business Partnering)

  • Verantwortung für Budget, Forecast und Mehrjahresplanung inklusive P&L-, Bilanz- und Cash-Planung sowie Analyse und Kommentierung wesentlicher Abweichungen

  • Weiterentwicklung der finanziellen und operativen Steuerung mit Fokus auf Wachstum, Umsatz, Marge, Profitabilität und Cash-Bedarf

  • Analyse zentraler Werttreiber wie Neukundengewinnung, Pricing, Akquisitionskosten, Kundenbindung sowie Produkt- und Partnerkosten

  • Steuerung von Finanzierungsvolumen, Forderungen, Unit Economics sowie Ergebnis-, Funding- und Cash-Entwicklung

  • Erstellung von Business Cases, Szenario- und Sensitivitätsanalysen für neue Produkte, Kooperationen und Wachstumsinitiativen

  • Erstellung adressatengerechter Management- und Board-Reportings sowie Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen

Qualifikation

  • Sie haben ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Controlling, Finance oder Rechnungswesen abgeschlossen.

  • Sie verfügen über mindestens fünf Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Controlling.

  • Sie sind mit Controlling in Unternehmensgruppen vertraut.

  • Sie arbeiten sehr sicher mit gängigen ERP-Systemen und Excel und setzen PowerPoint für Entscheidungsunterlagen ein.

  • Sie kommunizieren sicher mit dem Management und verfügen über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

Arbeitsort ist Frankfurt am Main. Bei der angebotenen Position handelt es sich um eine Vollzeitstelle in Festanstellung.

  • Sie erhalten Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung und beruflichen Entwicklung.

  • Sie profitieren von flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen und der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten.

  • Sie können eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und einen Zuschuss zur Ausstattung für mobiles Arbeiten nutzen.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Bei Fragen steht Ihnen Herr Marcus Heinrich, unter der Rufnummer 0179 / 12 92 419 gerne zur Verfügung.

data.description:
Wir von FAVELA Clothing GmbH sind ein aufstrebendes Unternehmen im Bereich Textilien, Bekleidung & Lederwaren. Mit unserem authentischen und urbanen Style setzen wir uns von der Masse ab und erfreuen uns zunehmender Beliebtheit bei unseren Kunden. Als Art Director / Illustrator / Grafik-Designer (m/w/d) bei uns hast du die Chance, dich kreativ auszuleben und maßgeblich dazu beizutragen, dass unsere Produkte immer topaktuell und einzigartig sind. Du wirst Teil eines motivierten Teams, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und gemeinsam das Unternehmen voranbringt. Wir bieten dir eine faire Bezahlung und die Möglichkeit, dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Werde jetzt Teil unseres dynamischen Unternehmens und bewirb dich bei uns!

  • Du bist zuständig für die Reinzeichnung und Erzeugung druckfähiger Daten

  • Du entwickelst Icons und Illustrationen

data.description:
Deine Mission

Kurz vorab: Diese Stelle richtet sich an Leute mit echter Erfahrung. Du steuerst seit mindestens drei Jahren eigenverantwortlich Werbebudgets auf Meta und Google und hast zuletzt mindestens 50.000 Euro im Monat selbst verantwortet. Wenn das auf dich zutrifft und du Lust auf Tempo und Verantwortung hast, bist du hier richtig. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam im Office im Herzen Münchens, weil wir im Team am schnellsten sind.

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Performance unserer Kunden auf Meta und Google. Du entscheidest, wohin das Budget geht, was getestet wird und was skaliert. Du liest Zahlen so, dass du die Ursache findest und nicht nur das Symptom. Und du erklärst Kunden klar, was passiert und was als Nächstes kommt.

Konkret

  • Du steuerst Meta- und Google-Ads-Konten für E-Commerce- und Leadgen-Brands, von der Struktur bis zur Skalierung.
  • Du planst Budgets und Tests und entscheidest nach Profitabilität, nicht nur nach ROAS.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Creative-Team und sagst, welche Creatives deine Konten als Nächstes brauchen.
  • Du behältst Tracking und Datenqualität im Blick: Conversions API, Enhanced Conversions und GA4.
  • Du führst Kundengespräche auf Augenhöhe, auch wenn die Zahlen mal schlecht sind.
  • Du nutzt AI-Tools für Analyse, Reporting und Routine und gibst dein Wissen im Team weiter.

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Steuerung von Meta und Google Ads.
  • Du hast zuletzt Monatsbudgets ab 50.000 Euro selbst verantwortet.
  • Du kennst E-Commerce- oder Leadgen-Konten aus der Praxis und kannst konkrete Ergebnisse nennen.
  • Du verstehst Attribution, Tracking und Unit Economics gut genug, um Zahlen zu hinterfragen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar, mit Kunden und im Team.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, weil du mit unseren Kunden sprichst.
  • Du wohnst in München oder ziehst für den Job her. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam im Office.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn

  • du Verantwortung für Ergebnisse willst und nicht nur für Aufgaben.
  • du Entscheidungen mit Zahlen begründest.
  • du im Team besser wirst und andere besser machst.
  • du neugierig auf AI bist und sie im Alltag einsetzt.

Noch nicht passend ist die Rolle, wenn

  • du gerade erst ins Performance Marketing einsteigst.
  • du Kampagnen bisher vor allem nach Vorgabe umgesetzt hast.

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung mit TikTok oder Pinterest Ads.
  • Erfahrung mit Shopify, Klaviyo oder serverseitigem Tracking.
  • Agenturerfahrung mit mehreren Kunden gleichzeitig.

Warum wir?

  • Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag: eigene Kunden, eigene Budgets, eigene Entscheidungen.
  • Ein starkes Creative-Team im Haus, das liefert, was deine Konten brauchen.
  • Eigene AI-Workflows für Analyse und Reporting, damit du Zeit für Strategie hast.
  • Motiviertes High-Performance-Team, keine Politik, flache Hierarchien.
  • Spannende E-Commerce- und Leadgen-Brands (Food, Beauty, Lifestyle).
  • Benefitpaket mit Sachbezug, Wellpass, Mittagessen und Deutschlandticket.
  • Modernes, zentrales Office am Gärtnerplatz in München.
  • Team-Events, Workshops und Weiterbildungen.

Darauf schauen wir

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Wichtig sind uns dein Lebenslauf und deine Antworten im Bewerbungsformular. Dort fragen wir nach deiner Erfahrung, deinem Budget und einem Konto, das du selbst gesteuert hast. Antworte bitte mit Zahlen.

Wenn du dich über ein anderes Portal bewirbst, schreib diese drei Angaben bitte in deinen Lebenslauf: Jahre Erfahrung, zuletzt verantwortetes Monatsbudget und ein Konto mit Ergebnis.

So geht es danach weiter: Videocall, eine kurze Case-Aufgabe, ein Probetag bei uns im Office mit persönlichem Gespräch, dann unsere Entscheidung.

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our AI Platform Teams

Our AI Platform teams build the infrastructure that powers Wayve’s embodied AI. We store and serve hundreds of petabytes of driving data, growing towards exabyte scale, to support model training, simulation and data pipelines across regions and clouds.

As our first dedicated Staff Software Engineer for Storage Platform, you’ll set the technical direction for how we manage, protect and serve this data. Working closely with Infrastructure, Security, Privacy, Data Engineering and ML teams, you’ll help make training more efficient while reducing one of Wayve’s largest infrastructure costs.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Lead a hands-on, multi-quarter storage programme, from defining the problems and architecture to delivering platforms that teams adopt.

  • Build production services, controllers and infrastructure using Python, Go or a similar language, alongside Kubernetes and Terraform.

  • Partner with ML and data teams to understand access patterns, remove storage bottlenecks and reduce the time GPUs spend waiting for data.

  • Work with Security and Privacy to strengthen access controls, auditing and safe deletion of vehicle-collected data.

  • Write design documents and RFCs, align teams around shared standards, and mentor engineers as the platform and team grow.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Data ownership and governance: Give datasets clear owners, purposes and retention classes, with tagging and team-level cost attribution.

  • Safe lifecycle management: Build retention, deletion and re-tiering capabilities for Azure Blob, backed by dry runs, audit trails and recovery paths.

  • Read performance and caching: Improve throughput and latency by tackling small-object reads, throttling, unnecessary data access and cross-region hops.

  • Secure data movement: Design Kubernetes-native NVMe caching and secure replication across regions and clouds.

  • Measurable platform outcomes: Establish standards, dashboards and SLOs for availability, performance, cache effectiveness, storage tiers and cost.

🙌 You should apply if

  • You’ve operated at Staff Engineer scope, leading complex infrastructure programmes across multiple teams from problem definition through adoption.

  • You’ve owned petabyte-scale object storage end to end—including data layout, lifecycle management, performance and cost—with measurable outcomes against a cost target.

  • You’ve built scalable systems for data ownership, tagging, cataloguing, retention or deletion.

  • You bring strong security and access-management experience, including IAM/RBAC, encryption, secure replication and auditing.

  • You’re a hands-on software engineer with strong Python, Go or comparable skills, plus production Kubernetes, Terraform and CI experience. You build durable platforms and services, not just one-off scripts.

  • You can influence technical decisions without formal authority, mentor others and are excited to start in a founding, hands-on role with the opportunity to grow a team.

  • You can work on a hybrid basis from our London office.

Experience with AWS or GCP is welcome—you don’t need to have worked exclusively with Azure.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) - A conversation with our Talent Partner about your experience, interest in the role and practical details.

  • Competency Interviews (60 mins) - A programming interview to assess your hands-on software engineering skills.

  • Deep-dive technical interviews - A system design interview and a domain-specific interview with the Hiring Manager, exploring your storage experience, technical leadership and approach to the role.

  • Final interview (30 mins) - Mission & values alignment

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

data.title: Complex Credit Hire Handler
data.description:
We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

About the team

This role owns a varied portfolio, including specialist credit hire claims such as taxi and motorbike hire, ensuring that liability and indemnity is investigated, setting accurate reserves and negotiating settlement.

It supports our goals around fair, efficient claims outcomes and strong loss-ratio performance.

What you'll be doing

  • Manage a portfolio of Third Party Property Damage (TPPD) and Credit Hire claims, progressing them efficiently in line with our processes.

  • Handle credit hire claims across specialist vehicle types, including taxi and motorbike hire, applying the correct rates, hire periods and agreements.

  • Triage and manage inbound communications effectively, routing work to support timely claim resolution.

  • Investigate claims and assess liability and indemnity with policyholders, witnesses and third parties to identify recovery opportunities and make sound decisions.

  • Keep policyholders informed with clear, empathetic communication throughout their claim journey.

  • Set and maintain claim reserves and process payments in line with our reserving approach.

  • Detailed notes left on the claims system, explaining action, trail of through and next steps.

  • Accurate reserve setting on files to reflected expected payouts.

  • Housekeeping to ensure accuracy on our claims system.

  • Professional communication either with the customer or the third party representatives.

We offer a flexible hybrid work model, with the team coming together at our London office once every two weeks.

Your expertise

  • Hands-on experience managing Credit Hire and Third Party Property Damage (TPPD) claims, including challenging hire periods, rates, and credit hire agreements.

  • Experience handling credit hire claims across specialist vehicle types, including taxi and motorbike hire.

  • Confidence in negotiating settlements over the phone and email.

  • Solid grasp of relevant case law and when to apply it, and confidence discussing liability and indemnity decisions.

  • Comfortable setting and maintaining reserves and processing payments within agreed authority levels, with a track record of sound, independent decision-making.

  • Used to managing a varied caseload at pace, prioritising effectively and keeping claimants and third parties informed throughout.

Who you are

  • You balance commercial judgement with a customer-focused approach.

  • You make decisions confidently and know when to escalate for another view.

  • You stay organised and prioritise well when managing multiple cases at pace.

  • You look for better ways of working and support wider team goals, not just your own caseload.

Perks & benefits

  • Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

  • Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

  • Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

  • Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

Our process

  1. Initial call with a member of our Talent Acquisition team.

  2. Interview with two members of the Claims team.

We review every application and will always let you know the outcome, though we're unable to provide individual feedback at application stage.

#LI-PT1

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

data.title: Research Assistant – Cell Biology (Contractor)
data.description:
About Relation

Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure.

We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact.

We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age.

By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients.

The opportunity

Relation is offering an exciting opportunity for a Research Assistant with a background in Cell Biology to join an established team that are running perturbation screens to help drive novel target identification for drugs to cure complex human diseases. We are looking for a scientist with hands-on experience in functional genomics, phenotypic assays, data collection, analysis and interpretation.

In this role, you will be at the forefront of scientific discovery and make a meaningful impact in the field of biology, working at the intersection of science and technology within a rapidly growing TechBio company. You will partner closely with colleagues across Discovery, have the opportunity to develop your skills to work independently and advance your knowledge-base on assay development and optimisation.

Day to day, you will

  • Contribute to the design and execution of cellular and biochemical assays to support ongoing projects, including screening in established cell models and running phenotypic readouts

  • Growth and maintenance of primary and immortalised mammalian cell lines, taking responsibility for sample tracking and quality control (QC).

  • Assistance in management of reagent stock levels, equipment maintenance, laboratory upkeeping, and adherence to good laboratory practice.

  • Carrying out data analysis and relevant quality assurance protocols during the running of routine protocols

  • Communicate outcomes of your work to team members of the project and the broader company in written or verbal reports.

  • Proactive identification and timely communication of potential project concerns to senior project team members

  • Actively contribute to ideas of new technologies, workflows, and operational infrastructure.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional colleagues across biological and computational sciences and assist with solving complex scientific challenges and accelerate programme delivery

Professionally, you will have

  • Bachelor and/or Master's degree in a Biological Science.

  • Prior wet-lab experience working within academic, biotech, pharmaceutical or CRO environments

  • Strong practical experience in cell culture techniques including cell line generation and maintenance.

  • Experience in running arrayed genetic perturbation screens using CRISPR

  • Capability to run cell and molecular biological assays to characterise cell phenotype e.g. nucleic acids extraction, flow cytometry, RT-qPCR, ELISA etc.

About the role

As the Growth Manager for the UK-Kenya corridor, you'll drive LemFi's expansion across East African communities in one of our most critical markets. You will own direct influencer negotiations, manage external agencies, partners and key community leaders, and execute grassroots field marketing. You'll spend 3 to 5 days every few weeks in a new UK city, representing LemFi at East African community events, building partnerships, rigorously tracking campaign performance and accelerating user acquisition. You're embedded in the communities we serve, acting as both a strategic thinker and a ground-level operator. You will work across paid channels, organic strategy, local agency partners, and product teams to drive massive user acquisition in this market, while serving as the internal voice of the user.

 

What you'll build and own

  • Map, infiltrate, and build genuine presence inside East African diaspora associations, WhatsApp groups, and community networks across the UK, seeding LemFi authentically and tracking what drives real sign-ups.

  • Travel across the UK 3 to 5 days every few weeks, establishing on-the-ground presence in new cities. Lead community-driven initiatives to build trust, awareness and advocacy for LemFi. Organize and participate in local events, meetups and forums. Build and maintain strong relationships with community leaders and grassroots partners implementing tracking mechanisms to measure the exact customer acquisition cost of your offline activities.

  • Develop and execute comprehensive user acquisition strategies tailored to East African communities in the UK. Own growth targets for assigned markets and optimize campaigns using data and insights.

  • Source, negotiate directly with, and manage partnerships to accelerate user growth. Ensure partnerships deliver mutual value and measurable outcomes tied directly to user acquisition.

  • Conduct ongoing market research to understand user needs, behaviours and preferences. Provide actionable insights to Product and Marketing teams. Serve as the internal voice of the user, representing community perspectives in decision-making.

  • Own the full campaign lifecycle from concept to close: brief, execute, measure cost per acquisition and conversion to first-time transacting users, and iterate fast.

  • Identify new community touchpoints and partnership opportunities across the East African diaspora (Kenya, Rwanda, and broader East Africa) and bring them live quickly.

  • Use AI tools to accelerate your own output - drafting campaign copy, analysing performance data, and building outreach at scale - while applying your own judgement to validate every insight before acting on it.

Your experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in fast-paced environments with a background in growth, sales, marketing or similar.

  • Proven ability to work against targets and deliver measurable results. You're motivated by ambitious goals and comfortable being measured against clear KPIs.

  • Strong data-driven mindset. You interpret data, track performance and adjust strategies accordingly.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with diverse stakeholders. You're a persuasive communicator who can influence partners and leaders.

  • Entrepreneurial and tenacious. You take ownership, push through obstacles and find ways to win. Biased to action, you think critically and move quickly.

  • Self-motivated and effective working independently and in remote environments. You're willing to travel extensively and work occasional weekends to support market growth

Nice to have

  • Prior experience launching or scaling ventures in new markets.

Love shouldn’t be expensive, yet those working hardest for their families often face predatory fees and banking exclusion. We're changing this.

At LemFi, you won’t be just a cog in a machine. Whether designing products, scaling operations, or telling our story, you’ll tackle complex challenges with real, immediate impact. data.description:
LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South.

LemFi is building the financial infrastructure for the world's migrants and underserved communities, and credit is one of our fastest-growing bets. As Collections Manager you will sit at the intersection of strategy and operations, designing the frameworks that determine how we recover debt fairly and efficiently, then rolling your sleeves up to make sure those frameworks actually work in the field.

This is a Head of Collections role in a function that's still early. You'll set the strategy, but there's no large team or finished playbook underneath you yet, so you'll build as much as you direct.

You'll own collections end to end: policy, strategy, operations and the team, reporting into senior leadership. One day you're making the case for our risk appetite at board level. The next you're in the data working out why a workflow is breaking, and fixing it yourself. If you only want to work at one of those levels, this isn't the role for you.

What you'll build and own

Design and continuously refine the end-to-end collections strategy across all product lines, balancing recovery rates with a genuinely customer-first approach.

Set and own portfolio-level targets (roll rates, recovery rates, cure rates, cost per recovery) and hold the team accountable to them through clear, data-driven governance.

Build and iterate operational playbooks for each stage of the collections journey, from early arrears contact through to legal escalation, using AI tools to accelerate cycle times and personalise outreach.

Lead, coach and grow a collections team, creating clear prioritisation frameworks so the right problems get worked first and critical tasks never fall through the cracks.

Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Legal and Finance to embed collections logic into product decisions and ensure regulatory compliance across every market we operate in.

Identify and integrate third-party debt collection agencies, legal partners and credit bureaus where appropriate, managing those relationships for performance and conduct.

Report portfolio health and strategic recommendations to senior leadership in plain language, turning data into decisions rather than decks for their own sake.

Your experience

Significant experience in consumer (B2C) collections or credit risk.

Proven track record spanning both strategy design and hands-on operational delivery, not just one or the other.

Experience managing or building a collections team, with clear examples of setting priorities, developing people and holding performance to account.

Working knowledge of FCA CONC 7 (Arrears, Default and Recovery) and Consumer Duty obligations is required, you should be able to speak fluently to how these shape treatment paths, forbearance, and vulnerable customer handling, not just cite them.

Demonstrable ability to use data to diagnose portfolio problems, model scenarios and drive decisions, comfortable with SQL, BI tools or equivalent, and willing to bring AI into your workflow.

Experience working in a high-growth or fast-moving environment where processes were incomplete and you had to build as you flew.

Strong judgement about what to prioritise: able to distinguish between the problems that matter today and the noise, and able to instil that discipline in a team.

Nice to have

Experience across multiple geographies or emerging markets, particularly in Africa, South Asia or the diaspora corridor.

Background in a fintech, neobank or digital lender where collections was built from a relatively early stage.

Familiarity with collections-specific tooling (e.g. collections management systems, dialler platforms, predictive scoring models).

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

Join our sales team as an Account Executive to help us drive our UK & Ireland market! As an integral team member, you will report to the Sales Manager and work alongside motivated individuals passionate about changing how organisations manage their business travel.

We're looking for someone fearless in rolling up their sleeves, hitting the phones, and engaging with new customers to grow our client base. You should be hungry, perseverant, and focused, with excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills that enable you to win new clients and maintain strong relationships with existing ones. 

But that's not all - we also value collaboration and teamwork, so you should be just as motivated to help your colleagues succeed as you are to meet your targets. We take pride in our fun, challenging, and inclusive culture and seek someone who shares our passion for creating a positive work environment. If you're excited about the prospect of selling a disruptive product that is changing the game for business travel management, we want to hear from you!

What will you be doing?

  • Prospecting and managing outbound and inbound leads for the UK & Ireland market;

  • Presenting demos to potential clients and owning the follow-up until closing the deal (Full sales cycle);

  • Seeking to understand the needs of your target prospects and articulating the value that Perk provides which is most aligned to the needs of that customer;

  • Conducting high-level discussions with various stakeholders, from Office Managers to CFOs;

  • Maintaining accurate information on prospects and interaction activities in Salesforce;

  • Working closely with the Marketing team to develop new ways to increase awareness of Perk and to both evolve and improve the lead qualification process;

  • Become an expert in Perk and our ever-evolving features.

What will you need to succeed?

  • Excellent communication and video presentation skills;

  • Experience working with the UK and Irish Markets 

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken, as if it were your first language

  • Solid experience working in a Sales position and a demonstrated ability to be a pure hunter - proven track record of developing your pipeline through outbound initiatives;

  • Proven track record of developing successful relationships with C-suite executives;

  • Good understanding of B2B solution selling with a short sales cycle;

  • Being hungry and ambitious, yet ethical and sound;

  • Able to work as an individual contributor, but bearing in mind you are part of a team;

  • Customer-centric mindset;

  • Legal authorisation to work in the UK.

What we offer:

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

Interview process:

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Assessment interview with two TL's - 60mins - Virtual

  • Senior Leadership interview with SM and CM for the UKI team- 30mins IRL

  • Values interview - 30mins virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

About the Role

Our reps spend most of their day in Salesforce, and how it feels to use directly affects how much they sell. You'll join the global Salesforce team for 12 months to make the CRM faster, clearer and more intuitive.

This is a hands-on build role. You'll design the experience and code it in Lightning Web Components, working with Sales, RevOps, Marketing and Data, and directly with the reps who use the result.

Redesign the rep experience

  • Audit the current Lightning experience (record pages, console apps, list views, home pages) and find where reps lose time to clicks, clutter and missing context.

  • Create release notes, short walkthroughs and handover documentation so changes land well and the team can maintain what you build.

Work as part of the global team

  • Work within the global team's standards for source control, code review, sandboxes and release management.

  • Partner with admins, architects and data teams so UI changes fit the wider data model, security model and automation.

  • Pass on what you learn about Lightning UX patterns and LWC best practices to the wider team.


What You Will Need


Must have

  • Experience with Salesforce DX, Git and a CI/CD or deployment process.

  • A UX mindset: you start from user problems, can explain design decisions, and can take feedback from non-technical users.

  • Clear communication and the ability to work independently across time zones in a global team.

Nice to have

  • Portfolio or examples of Salesforce UI work you've shipped (screenshots or demos are ideal).

  • Experience in Sales Cloud, especially rep-facing workflows such as opportunity management, account planning and pipeline views.

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About The Role

Strategy, Planning and Operations (SPO) is the layer that connects Marketing: the planning rhythm, the budget and the administrative coordination that keeps the team aligned and moving in the same direction. As SPO Specialist, you'll support Marketing Leadership in keeping that layer working well. You'll run the quarterly OKR cadence and the marketing calendar, manage budgeting and PO processes, and look after team operations, from onboarding and the Learning & Development programme to offsites and events.

You'll also spend time embedded with teams such as Content, Product Marketing or Social Media to set up their operations or support a major launch. Throughout, you'll use Asana and AI to remove admin friction and improve how all Marketing teams work together. It's a hands-on, cross-functional role for someone who wants to support a large team.

Marketing experience is a plus. Admin or operational experience is essential.

  • Act as the link between Marketing and the AI/upskilling programme: surface where the team is spending time on repetitive work, and bring back relevant tools, prompts or agents

  • Support rollout of new AI-enabled processes — documentation, quick training, troubleshooting first use

Zip Water is an industry leading filtered boiling, chilled and sparkling water specialist, known globally for being home to the world’s most advanced range of drinking water solutions. We provide businesses and homes in more than 70 countries with an extensive range of high-quality drinking and hot water solutions, designed to transform the way individuals, organisations and businesses provide water, for good.

We are pleased to announce this exciting opportunity to join our Supply Chain team as a Claims & Returns Coordinator. This role is responsible for the end-to-end management, administration and continuous improvement of customer returns, carrier collections and transport claims processes. data.title: Senior Java Software Engineer
data.description:
Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.

Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.

Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.

La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

Votre rôle

Au sein de notre département R&D, vous rejoignez l’équipe Studio, en charge du développement de notre outil de conception et de configuration d’entrepôts robotisés.

De la modélisation d’un entrepôt en 3D au dimensionnement d’une solution Skypod (solution robotisée de stockage et de préparation de commandes pour les entrepôts logistiques), en passant par l’optimisation des coûts et la préparation du déploiement, Studio accompagne les équipes Exotec à chaque étape de leurs projets.

En tant que Senior Java Software Engineer, vous contribuez à faire évoluer cet outil stratégique en concevant et développant son backend et ses API. Vous intervenez sur des problématiques techniques variées, allant des moteurs de règles métier aux intégrations avec l’écosystème Exotec, avec un objectif : proposer des solutions fiables, performantes et adaptées aux besoins des utilisateurs.

En lien étroit avec les équipes techniques, produit et métier, vous participez activement aux choix de conception et à l’amélioration continue de Studio, afin de faciliter la conception et le déploiement des solutions robotiques Exotec à travers le monde.

Vos missions

  • Développer le backend de Studio : concevoir et faire évoluer les services Java et Spring Boot, les API et les fonctionnalités liées à la conception 3D, au dimensionnement des solutions et au calcul des coûts.
  • Concevoir les intégrations : développer et maintenir les connecteurs avec les outils de chiffrage, AutoCAD et les API de l’écosystème Exotec, notamment ICT et MCP.
  • Garantir la qualité du produit : assurer la performance, la robustesse et la fiabilité des applications, analyser les incidents de production et contribuer à l’amélioration continue du code.
  • Contribuer à la livraison continue : participer aux processus CI/CD, aux releases et à la validation des évolutions avec GitLab.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes : recueillir les besoins des utilisateurs, travailler avec les équipes produit, frontend, commerciales et projets, et participer aux rituels agiles de l’équipe.

Profil

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieurs ou d'une formation de niveau Bac+5 en informatique ou en informatique industrielle, et justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en développement web.

Vous disposez des compétences suivantes :

  • Vous maîtrisez Java et l’écosystème JEE, notamment Spring et Spring Boot.
  • Vous avez une bonne connaissance des technologies web et de la conception d’API.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec les bases de données relationnelles, notamment PostgreSQL, ainsi qu’avec les environnements Linux.
  • Vous maîtrisez les outils de gestion de versions et de développement collaboratif, notamment GitLab.
  • Vous connaissez idéalement un framework JavaScript, tel que React ou Vue.js.
  • Vous disposez d’un niveau d’anglais opérationnel.

Structuré(e), rigoureux(se) et imaginatif(ve), vous savez prendre des initiatives et proposer des solutions pragmatiques. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et êtes à l’aise pour collaborer avec des interlocuteurs aux profils variés, dans un environnement de travail convivial.

  • Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement

 

Chez Exotec, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances dans notre processus de recrutement. L’ensemble des candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’âge, du genre, de l’origine, de la religion, de la couleur de peau, de la nationalité, du sexe, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de toute autre distinction protégée par la loi. Votre rôle

Au sein de l’équipe R&D Reliability, composée de 6 ingénieurs, vous contribuez à améliorer les performances, la fiabilité et la disponibilité des systèmes robotiques Exotec.

Notre mission : exploiter les données et analyser les défaillances pour améliorer la robustesse et la durée de vie de nos systèmes, tout en réduisant les arrêts opérationnels.

À l’interface entre hardware et software, vous identifiez les causes racines des défaillances, développez des outils d’analyse et pilotez des améliorations techniques. Vous intervenez sur l’ensemble du système, de l’analyse des données terrain au développement et à la validation de solutions concrètes.

Au sein de l’équipe R&D Reliability, vos missions sont les suivantes :

  • Analyser les défaillances et améliorer la fiabilité : exploiter les données terrain, identifier les principaux modes de panne, rechercher les causes racines et définir des actions correctives et préventives.
  • Développer des outils d’analyse : concevoir vos propres outils software pour exploiter les données, diagnostiquer les problèmes et évaluer les performances des systèmes.
  • Développer et tester des solutions logicielles : réaliser des développements de software embarqué en autonomie afin de tester vos améliorations et de résoudre des problématiques à l’interface entre hardware et software.
  • Contribuer à l’évolution des systèmes : travailler avec les équipes de conception pour améliorer les composants, les sous-systèmes et les architectures hardware.
  • Concevoir et réaliser des essais : définir des protocoles de test, mener des expérimentations sur des systèmes dédiés à la R&D et mesurer l’efficacité des améliorations apportées.
  • Enrichir votre connaissance des systèmes sur le terrain : participer au support client pour mieux comprendre les conditions d’utilisation, investiguer les problèmes rencontrés et identifier de nouvelles pistes d’amélioration.

Votre profil

  • Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation supérieure technique en mécatronique, systèmes embarqués, génie industriel ou dans un domaine connexe, ou vous avez acquis une expérience équivalente.
  • Vous avez une expérience en conception, développement ou validation de systèmes techniques et manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche de panne et l’analyse des causes racines.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils de développement, le versioning et l’analyse de données.
  • Vous appréciez les problématiques à l’interface entre software et hardware et êtes capable de comprendre les interactions entre les différents composants d’un système.
  • Vous êtes familier(ère) avec les méthodes quantitatives appliquées à la fiabilité : MTTF, MTBF, loi de Weibull ou analyse statistique des défaillances.
  • Vous êtes curieux(se), structuré(e) et rigoureux(se), avec une approche méthodique de la résolution de problèmes.
  • Vous savez remettre en question vos hypothèses, approfondir vos analyses et rechercher de nouvelles connaissances lorsque cela est nécessaire.
  • Vous aimez collaborer avec des ingénieurs aux expertises variées, qu’elles soient orientées hardware, software ou systèmes.
  • Vous disposez d’un niveau d’anglais opérationnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

Benefits

  • Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive
  • Politique famille avantageuse
  • Programme de mobilité interne et internationale

data.title: Senior Product Manager
data.description:
About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.


Your Mission

  • Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
  • 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
  • Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
  • Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
  • Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
  • AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
  • Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
  • Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
  • Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
  • AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
  • Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
  • Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
  • Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
  • Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
  • Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.

Nice to Have
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Experience in fintech or another regulated industry.
  • Early-stage startup background.
  • Hands-on LLM orchestration or prompt engineering.
  • Background in software engineering, QA or product analytics.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol and Berlin offices, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

data.title: Security Engineer (Hybrid or Remote)
data.description:
About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.

We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.


Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.
  • Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice.
  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.
Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense
  • Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation.
  • Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results.
Automation & Ownership

  • Own the roadmap for your areas: identify gaps, lead initiatives independently, and raise the bar rather than just maintain it.


Your Profile

data.title: CDI - CREATIVE DESIGNER - BRAND CONCEPTS (H/F)
data.description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).
 
 
 
VOTRE RÔLE

Vous contribuez au développement de l'identité de JACQUEMUS à travers les concept image, défilés, projets spéciaux, Beauté, expérience et l'ensemble des supports de communication de la Maison. Vous imaginez de nouveaux langages graphiques, développez des concepts créatifs avec le Brand Concepts Director et accompagnez leur déploiement sur l'ensemble des points de contact.

 

VOS MISSIONS

  • Participer au développement des concepts créatifs des projets spéciaux, collaborations et initiatives de Brand Expansion.
  • Participer au développement des identités visuelles des campagnes, collections, défilés et projets spéciaux, de leur conception à leur déclinaison.
  • Développer les systèmes graphiques, lettrages, traitements typographiques et directions artistiques associés.
  • Réaliser des recherches créatives, iconographiques et graphiques pour alimenter les réflexions du Studio Image.
  • Concevoir les propositions graphiques des campagnes de communication et des grands temps forts de la Maison.
  • Concevoir les supports de communication liés aux défilés (invitations, moodboards, présentations, dossiers de presse…).
  • Développer les principes d'identité visuelle destinés au Retail Design, aux expériences de marque et aux activations.
  • Participer au développement de nouveaux formats digitaux, motion et contenus innovants.
  • Encadrer la déclinaison graphique des identités sur les différents supports.
  • Assurer la cohérence créative de l'ensemble des livrables en collaboration avec les équipes Image, Retail, Digital et Communication.

 

VOTRE PROFIL 

  • Excellente culture graphique et artistique.
  • Très forte maîtrise de l'identité visuelle, de la typographie et des systèmes graphiques.
  • Capacité à développer des concepts créatifs.
  • Excellente maîtrise de Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects et Premiere.
  • Aisance avec Keynote et PowerPoint.
  • Très bonne maîtrise du motion design.
  • Intérêt voire maîtrise d’outils IA appliquée à la création.
  • Capacité à travailler de manière transversale avec plusieurs équipes.
 
Le poste est situé rue de Lisbonne dans le 8è arrondissement de Paris.

data.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
data.description:
Diabolocom is the leading European sovereign cloud contact center (CCaaS) and customer experience management (CX) platform. It helps organizations transform customer experience by augmenting agents' capabilities through AI-human collaboration, automating routine customer interactions, and delivering personalized experiences at scale. Built on proprietary AI, private cloud, and native telecom infrastructure, the platform automates workflows, improves data quality, and empowers customer service and sales teams across every channel. 
 
Backed by more than two decades of experience and twice recognized by Frost & Sullivan for AI technology innovation and customer experience technology leadership, Diabolocom is trusted by more than 400 organizations—including BPCE, Carrefour, Nikon, and Mitsubishi—to power mission-critical customer operations in over 60 countries, helping organizations strengthen customer loyalty and accelerate growth.


About the role

To support our growth, we are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to join our HR team in Paris.

You will manage recruitment processes end-to-end, from understanding the hiring need and identifying the right sourcing strategy to interviewing candidates, managing the selection process and closing the hire.

A significant part of your activity will involve recruiting technical and highly specialized profiles, including Software Engineers, AI and Research profiles, Infrastructure experts, senior technical specialists and, depending on business needs, leadership and C-level positions.

You will work with a wide variety of stakeholders across the company: experienced hiring managers, technical experts, senior leaders and managers who may need more guidance throughout the recruitment process. Being able to adapt your approach, challenge when necessary and keep recruitment processes moving will therefore be an important part of your role.

You will join a collaborative Talent Acquisition team composed of a Talent Acquisition Team Lead, another Talent Acquisition Manager and an HR team member combining recruitment with broader HR projects, within the HR department.

We are looking for someone who is already comfortable managing recruitment independently, while remaining curious and eager to learn, develop their expertise and adopt our recruitment practices.


What you will do

  • Manage recruitment processes from A to Z, from the initial briefing with the hiring manager through sourcing, interviews, coordination of the selection process, offer management and contract signature.

  • Partner with hiring managers to understand their needs, challenge requirements when relevant and translate them into an effective recruitment and sourcing strategy.

  • Recruit across a variety of roles, with a strong focus on technical and complex profiles, including senior Software Engineers, AI/Research profiles, Infrastructure specialists, technical leadership and other hard-to-find profiles.

  • Take ownership of direct sourcing and headhunting, identifying and engaging passive candidates rather than relying primarily on inbound applications.

  • Build relevant talent pools and continuously explore new sourcing channels, tools and approaches.

  • Conduct structured interviews to assess candidates' experience, skills, motivations and potential fit with the role and environment.

  • Provide hiring managers with clear, fact-based candidate assessments and recommendations throughout the selection process.

  • Manage candidate communication throughout the recruitment journey and contribute to a professional, transparent and engaging candidate experience.

  • Adapt your way of working to different stakeholders, from very experienced senior leaders to managers who require more support in structuring their recruitment process.

  • Keep our ATS and recruitment data accurate and up to date and contribute to the monitoring of key recruitment indicators.

  • Share market insights with the team and hiring managers, including candidate availability, compensation expectations, competitive dynamics and sourcing challenges.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement projects within Talent Acquisition, such as sourcing practices, interview methodologies, candidate experience, automation, documentation and recruitment processes.

  • Work closely with the rest of the Talent Acquisition and HR team, sharing knowledge, candidates, sourcing techniques and best practices.


    • What we are looking for

  • You already have a first solid experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally around 3 to 5 years, either in-house or in a recruitment agency/search environment.

  • You are able to manage a recruitment process independently from initial briefing to hire, while knowing when to ask for input or collaborate with the team.

  • You have already recruited technical and/or particularly complex profiles. Previous exposure to Software Engineering, AI/Data, Infrastructure, Research or senior technical positions would be particularly relevant.

  • You are comfortable working on senior and hard-to-find profiles and understand that some searches require persistence, creativity and a highly targeted approach.

  • Direct sourcing is part of your recruiter DNA: you are comfortable approaching passive candidates and using tools and techniques such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean searches, talent mapping and other relevant sourcing channels.

  • You are comfortable interacting with stakeholders at different levels of seniority, including senior leaders and C-level executives, and can adapt your communication and level of guidance accordingly.

  • You know how to manage several recruitment processes simultaneously, prioritize effectively and maintain momentum even when working with busy stakeholders.

  • You combine autonomy with a strong team mindset: you take ownership of your searches but naturally share information, help colleagues and contribute to collective recruitment goals.

  • You are curious and eager to keep developing your recruitment expertise. You already have strong foundations, but you are still keen to learn new approaches, tools and practices.

  • You have strong interpersonal and communication skills and care about building high-quality relationships with both candidates and hiring managers.

  • Ability to build, manage and improve recruitment dashboards would be a strong plus for this role.

  • You are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.

  • Spanish would be a strong plus, as would experience recruiting across several European or international markets.


    • What's in it for you

  • A structured onboarding program to discover our product, technology, teams and culture.

  • Exposure to an international environment and stakeholders across multiple countries.

  • A Talent Acquisition team where you can operate autonomously while continuing to learn and develop your expertise.
