As Yubo continues to scale, Machine Learning is becoming a core production layer, powering critical systems across safety, recommendations, and product optimization.

What makes this role unique is both the scale and diversity of our data, and the level of maturity we are aiming to reach.

We process massive volumes of images, text, and real-time user interactions, across millions of users worldwide, creating a wide range of high-impact ML challenges, including:

  • Content moderation (image, text, behavior)

  • Recommendation systems and user engagement optimization

  • Behavioral detection and trust & safety models

  • Emerging use cases such as dynamic pricing and growth optimization

At the same time, our current ML stack is still evolving.
Legacy models are not fully integrated into pipelines, lifecycle management remains inconsistent, and our approach can sometimes resemble “develop, deploy, and forget.”

As ML usage expands across the company, this creates increasing complexity and dependency on reliable, well-structured systems.

There is still a huge amount of untapped potential, with many ML use cases yet to be designed, tested, and scaled, but unlocking it requires building a more robust and scalable ML operating model.

We are therefore looking for a Senior ML Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team, reporting directly to Mikael (Head of Platform Engineering).

You will play a key role in delivering ML initiatives across the company, helping turn promising ideas into reliable production systems. You'll work on everything from model development and experimentation to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement, while contributing to the evolution of our ML platform and engineering practices

Your responsibilities

 

ML Systems & Delivery

  • Deliver end-to-end ML use cases (recommendation systems, safety algorithms, moderation models, etc.).

  • Design, train, evaluate, and deploy ML models where appropriate.

  • Balance speed of delivery with robustness and reliability.

ML Lifecycle & Reliability

  • Drive improvements across the ML lifecycle (training, deployment, monitoring, iteration).

  • Establish KPIs and monitoring standards to track model performance over time.

  • Ensure continuous alignment with product and safety objectives.

  • Help improve the reliability and observability of production ML systems.

Platform & Standardization

  • Contribute to the evolution of our ML platform through tools, workflows, and reusable components.

  • Help establish and promote scalable ML engineering practices across teams.

  • Contribute to improving self-service ML capabilities where relevant.

Legacy & Advanced Use Cases

  • Take ownership of legacy models and realign them with current business needs.

  • Improve, retrain, and integrate them into modern pipelines.

  • Contribute to best practices around LLM usage in moderation, recommendation, and other product domains.

  • Explore and implement advanced ML approaches where relevant.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Data Engineering, MLOps, Backend Platform, and Product teams.

  • Act as a bridge between ML, platform, and business stakeholders.

  • Provide technical leadership on ML initiatives and help improve engineering practices across teams.

  • Share knowledge and help raise the overall ML maturity of the organization.

 

Our technical environment / ML scope

  • ML frameworks: PyTorch

  • Languages: Python (data stack)

  • Core topics: Neural networks, LLMs, data sampling

  • Use cases: Recommendation systems, safety algorithms, moderation

  • Ecosystem: Data Engineering, MLOps pipelines, Backend Platform

 

Who you are

  • You have 5+ years of experience in ML / Data, including work on large-scale datasets (datasets of hundreds of gigabytes).

  • You have strong expertise in modern ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch or JAX).

  • You are highly proficient in Python (data ecosystem).

  • You have strong knowledge of neural networks and practical experience with LLM-based systems.

  • You understand ML systems end-to-end (data → training → deployment → monitoring).

  • You have strong experience in production ML systems, not only research.

  • You demonstrate strong product sense and can align models with business needs.

  • You are pragmatic and impact-driven, balancing experimentation with delivery.

  • You are able to explain complex ML topics clearly (strong pedagogy).

  • You operate well under ambiguity and can structure complex problems.

  • You are able to drive technical decisions and influence stakeholders through expertise and collaboration.

 

In your first 6 months, you will

  • Deliver an end-to-end ML use case to validate impact and execution.

  • Audit and improve lifecycle management of existing ML models.

  • Refactor and retrain at least one legacy safety model.

  • Build reusable ML components that improve development efficiency across teams.

  • Improve monitoring and observability of production ML systems.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our ML platform and engineering practices.

  • Help move critical ML systems toward more reliable and measurable long-term operation.

The recruitment process

What we offer

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

data.title: Scientific Product Director, Clinical Prediction
data.description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The role

Our clinical-prediction offer gives pharma partners the evidence to guide decisions before and during clinical development. We are looking for a Scientific Product Director to turn this science into sellable products: decide what gets developed and when, define what each capability can claim and output, and shape how results are delivered to partners.

You will report to Gustave Ronteix, CTO and co-founder, and work daily with a tight-knit interdisciplinary team composed of Computational Biology, Data Science, R&D, Platform Strategy & Operations, BD and Pharma Partnerships.

What you'll do

1. Own the product roadmap

  • Design and build a scalable product capable of derisking and accelerating clinical development of drug candidates based on Orakl’s scientific capabilities

  • Turn signals from BD, Pharma Partnerships and R&D into capability definitions: specs, target metrics, validation plan, in- vs out-of-scope definition, cost to deliver

  • Set priorities and dates with Engineering and Data Science; flag slippage early and make the trade-offs

  • Identify productization-gaps from delivery audits and analysis, and feed recurring ones back into the roadmap

2. Oversee product maturity and decide what we sell

  • Maintain the capability catalog: what is available now, in beta or on the roadmap, and what each can and cannot claim

  • Contribute to the final decision of when a capability is ready to sell (based on Data Science’s validation evidence) versus what is not-yet sellable in the pipeline, and communicate it internally

  • Oversee the scientific case for each capability: white papers, application notes, posters

3. Design how results reach partners

  • Design the reports, data packages and dashboards partners receive, and direct the engineers who build them

  • Own the deliverable contents: figures, statistical summaries, methods, limitations

  • Embed the approved claims and the QC checklist in every template, so Pharma Partnerships can produce a correct deliverable at scale

  • Keep templates current as the validated envelope changes, and pull or revise one when it no longer applies

What we're looking for

Must have

  • PhD or equivalent in cancer biology, pharmacology, biostatistics or computational biology

  • 8+ years in translational oncology, biomarker or diagnostics development, computational-biology platforms or preclinical CRO services, including 2+ owning a product roadmap

  • Technical depth: you read and understand production code, and can brief and review the work of engineers who build our reports and dashboards

  • You judge evidence: from a validation pack - back-tests, calibration, biomarker cutoffs -, you can state a claim the data supports and refuse the one it doesn't

  • You have experience working at the intersection of scientific and business departments within fast-growing companies

  • You know how pharma decides: you have seen proposals, SOWs and due-diligence questions, and know what a go/no-go decision needs from a prediction

  • Fluent in English

Nice to have

  • You have seen bespoke research work turned into something repeatable and sellable

  • Scientific authorship: Posters, talks, papers or white papers; a presence at AACR, ASCO, ESMO or SITC

  • Regulatory: exposure to regulated or quality-managed environments

  • Therapeutic or preclinical knowledge: ADC, immuno-oncology or targeted therapy; organoid or in-vitro pharmacology

  • Clinical-trial design or Trial statistics: adaptive designs, sample size, endpoints

  • Templated reporting: report-generation frameworks or web front-end

What we offer

  • Mission: work on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Ownership: a product function to build from the ground up.

  • Impact: pharma teams make real portfolio decisions with what you define.

  • Team: an exceptional crew of clinicians, biologists, engineers and data scientists, most with a PhD.

👉 More about Orakl here and here

Interview process

  1. Intro call (30 min) with Gustave Ronteix, CTO

  2. Case interview (1h)

  3. Case study (take-home)

  4. Conversations with BD, Pharma Partnerships, the Engineering / Data Science leads and Platform Strategy & Operations.

  5. References: 2-3, including a direct manager

data.title: Devops Engineer
data.description:
As a DevOps Engineer, you will be an integral part of an existing team comprising sixseven DevOps professionals. You will play a vital role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure and the internal platform built on it, which serves over 1800+ client companies, with 2.5+ million registered users and 30,000 daily active users. 

You will collaborate closely with all engineering squads including Development, Architecture, AI, and Data teams, to ensure the smooth and efficient delivery of our SaaS product. Our objective is to treat our infrastructure as a product for our developers, managing its complexity so they don’t have to. We provide simple, ready-to-use tools that enable them to build, deploy, and run their services efficiently.. Your expertise will be crucial in driving continuous improvement and fostering innovation within our DevOps and Platform Engineering practices.

You will have the opportunity to:

- Make a tangible impact in a rapidly evolving company. You will be responsible for building and maintaining a scalable infrastructure (accommodating more developers, more customers, and expansion into more countries) while optimizing resources (monitoring costs, reducing toil, and improving time to market) to support our growing activities.

- Engage in the continuous enhancement of our practices and undertake challenging and comprehensive projects. If you are interested in topics like SRE practices and platform engineering, you will play a key role in our transformation.

- Establish your own niche within a highly-skilled team that is eager to learn, share knowledge, and progress together.


Within 1 month, you will
  • Discover 360Learning, its platform, its teams and its culture.
  • Become familiar with our R&D way of working.
  • Understand the team’s processes.

    • Within 3 months, you will
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and management using tools like Terraform, Ansible and Helm.
  • Automate the deployment of applications, configurations and infrastructure to achieve a high level of flexibility and confidence in production setups and deployment processes.
  • Improve our global security, challenge our worldwide scaling, increase our performance.

    • Within 6 months, you will:
  • Collaborate with other squads to implement and improve our DevOps practices.
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement solutions to improve system stability and availability.
  • Manage and maintain our Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Ensure the security and compliance of our systems and data.
  • Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support.
  • Manage incidents and post-mortem.
  • Work closely with developers to facilitate their daily tasks, help them conform to best practices and ensure environments meet requirements  (e.g.: simplify and automate the deployment process, provide metrics and monitoring to the engineering squads).
  • Build and improve our internal platform: easy-to-deploy tools and templates that move infrastructure work off the squads' plate ("shift down"), so developers can ship without being infrastructure experts.
  • Improve monitoring and load testing to secure and enhance the performance of our infrastructure

    • Within 12 months, you will:
  • Actively participate in DevOps decisions for all critical projects related to our platform’s performance and reliability.
  • Evangelize and train our R&D team on Devops culture by defining all best practices and building them into the platform by default.

    • The Skill Set
  • 3+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer or in a similar role.
  • Ideally, you have worked in a tech or a SaaS company
  • You know how to run systems in production
  • Interest in platform engineering and developer experience: you like building tools that other engineers enjoy using
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, GitOps).
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Strong understanding of networking, security, and system administration.
  • You have a coding background (scripting, programming)
  • Passion for automation and continuous improvement.
  • You have working proficiency in English (level B2 or equivalent)Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR)
  • Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here:  https://bit.ly/Convexity_360L

    • Our technical stack

  • Cloud: Azure Cloud

  • Container orchestration: k8s, ArgoCD

  • Infra as Code: Terraform, AnsibleHelm

  • Monitoring tool: Datadog

  • Database: MongoDB Atlas

  • Application language: Javascript


    • What we offer:
  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈
  • Benefits/Perks: Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent. 
  • Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter 🌎🌏🌍
  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture:https://bit.ly/Convexity_360L & find out more about the teams, product and processes https://bit.ly/42H1ggC 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆

    • Interview Process:
  • Phone Screen with our Talent Acquisition Manager
  • Discovery Meeting with our Lead Devops Engineer
  • Case Study to do at home and to discuss with a Devops Engineer
  • Clarification Meeting with a Devops Engineer
  • Culture-fit Meeting with our VP Engineering
  • Offer!
    • Who We Are
    360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.

    360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

    Learning Includes Everyone.
    In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment. We want to learn from and with you!

data.title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) Freelance
data.description:
Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) 

Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées

À propos de l'opportunité

Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.

En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.

Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.

Vos missions

  • Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.

  • Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.

  • Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.

  • Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.

  • Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.

  • Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.

  • Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.

  • Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.

  • Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.

Ce que nous recherchons

Indispensable

  • Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.

  • Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.

  • Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.

  • Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.

  • La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.

  • Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux.

  • La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer.

  • Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.

  • La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

Atouts

  • Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.

  • Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.

Rémunération

Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés.

Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :

  • Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.

  • Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.

  • Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.

  • Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.

  • Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.

  • Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.

Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer.

Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.

  • Tu sais mener une discovery : interviewer, observer, et formuler clairement le vrai problème avant d'écrire la moindre ligne de code.

  • Tu apprends vite et tu adores plonger dans un métier qui n'est pas le tien.

  • Tu es orienté(e) impact : tu mesures ce que tu livres et tu t'appuies sur la data pour décider de la suite.

  • Tu aimes résoudre des problèmes complexes et tu sais embarquer des profils tech comme non-tech, sans autorité hiérarchique.

🏖 Congés payés: 7 à 10 jours de RTT (selon le nombre de jours ouvrés dans l'année) en plus de vos 28 jours de congés payés.

data.title: Sales Development Representative - CDI
data.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

 

Notre mission

 

Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation.

⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation. Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement”

👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 !

💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux !

 

Le mot de la CEO

“Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que nous nous sentons utiles, notre produit plaît et devient rapidement indispensable chez nos utilisateurs.
Rejoindre Solteo, c’est savoir écouter et rester attentif aux retours de nos clients et de notre marché, car ce sont eux qui façonnent la trajectoire de Solteo ! Ce produit, c’est avant tout le leur !” — Manon

 

Et ce poste alors ?

 

Le rôle

En première ligne de notre développement commercial, tu travailleras main dans la main avec le Sales Manager et les Account Executives au sein d'une équipe outillée et ambitieuse, sur un cycle de vente court.

 

Missions et responsabilités

  • Prospection intensive et ciblée (Outbound) : Identifier et qualifier des comptes clés dans le secteur de l'installation solaire. Tu contacteras les prospects via une approche multicanale avec une majorité de Cold Calling (notre cible d'artisans est très réceptive au téléphone), du Cold Emailing et LinkedIn.

  • Qualification des leads (Inbound & Outbound) : Traiter rapidement les demandes entrantes générées par le marketing. Tu devras qualifier les besoins lors des premiers appels de découverte et transformer l'intérêt en rendez-vous de démonstration qualifié pour l'équipe de closing.

  • Rigueur opérationnelle et Data : Assurer une tenue irréprochable de notre CRM (HubSpot) via la mise à jour des statuts, la prise de notes et le log des appels. Tu utiliseras notre stack et suivras tes KPIs quotidiens et hebdomadaires.

  • Amélioration continue : Remonter les objections fréquentes et les retours du terrain au VP Sales et au Marketing pour affiner le discours. Tu participeras activement aux sessions de coaching et de partage de bonnes pratiques de l'équipe.

 

Tes objectifs:

⭐ 0 à 1 mois : L'onboarding et les premiers pas
Acquérir une compréhension parfaite du produit Solteo, de la proposition de valeur et du marché cible. Prendre en main la stack technique (HubSpot, Aircall, Apollo) et lancer tes premières séquences de prospection et appels à froid pour générer tes premiers SQL.
🎯 Objectif : Maîtrise du pitch commercial, des outils de prospection et autonomie dans la génération de rendez-vous.

⭐ 1 à 8 mois : L'exécution et la machine à leads
Exécuter les séquences avec régularité et intensité. Atteindre et dépasser tes quotas de rendez-vous bookés. Devenir une machine de qualification tout en encaissant les refus sans perdre ta motivation.
🎯 Objectif : Alimenter continuellement les agendas des Account Executives avec des leads ultra-qualifiés.

⭐ À partir de 8 mois : Les premières démos (Closing)
C'est la concrétisation de ta montée en compétences ! Tu ne fais plus que prospecter : tu commences à prendre le relais sur la suite du cycle de vente en réalisant tes premières démonstrations produit auprès des prospects que tu as qualifiés.
🎯 Objectif : Maîtriser l'exercice de la démo et initier ta transition vers le closing.

⭐ >1 an : L'évolution
Participer à l'amélioration des process de prospection et transmettre ton savoir aux nouveaux arrivants.
🎯 Objectif : Évoluer officiellement vers un poste d'Account Executive (Closer) à temps plein ou prendre des responsabilités managériales au sein de l'équipe SDR.

 

Les compétences qu’on recherche

 

  • Formation : Tu as une expérience dans la vente SaaS B2B !

  • Mindset : Tu as un mindset d'entrepreneur, tu aimes relever des challenges et mettre la main à la pâte.

  • Humilité et capacité à se remettre en question : Forte envie de progresser et de prendre des responsabilités.

  • Langues : Français et Anglais parfaitement bilingues/fluents.

 

Ce qui serait un plus

  • Une expérience dans la Construction Tech ou l'Energy Tech, ou auprès des artisans et du bâtiment.

  • Une réelle motivation pour les projets à impact et la transition énergétique.

 

Mais Solteo c’est aussi…

Le rôle

Nous recherchons notre Founding Marketing Manager pour construire le moteur d'acquisition et de notoriété de Solteo. Premier recrutement marketing de l'entreprise, tu pars d'une page presque blanche : stratégie, canaux, budget et marque sont à construire, en lien direct avec Manon (CEO).

Missions et responsabilités

Tu prendras la responsabilité d'un périmètre produit de bout en bout : comprendre les problèmes de nos utilisateurs, identifier les meilleures opportunités, concevoir et cadrer les solutions avec l'équipe, les amener jusqu'en production et mesurer leur impact.

Nous cherchons surtout quelqu'un de très autonome, pragmatique et à l'aise dans un environnement startup, où tout n'est pas toujours parfaitement défini et où il faut savoir avancer, arbitrer et mettre les mains dans le cambouis.

Tu développes une compréhension fine de nos utilisateurs, de leurs usages et de leurs irritants. Tu combines échanges terrain, retours des équipes et analyse des données pour identifier et prioriser les opportunités à plus fort impact.

  1. Shaping & conception

Tu transformes des problèmes parfois encore flous en sujets bien cadrés et en solutions simples. Tu es capable de matérialiser rapidement une idée à travers des parcours, wireframes ou prototypes, et de la challenger avec les utilisateurs et l'équipe.

  1. Delivery & impact

Tu travailles étroitement avec les développeurs pour amener les sujets jusqu'en production, sans perdre de vue le problème initial. Une fois les fonctionnalités livrées, tu mesures leur adoption et leur impact pour comprendre ce qui fonctionne — ou non — et continuer à itérer.

  1. Ownership & autonomie

Tu n'attends pas que quelqu'un découpe précisément ton travail. Lorsque tu identifies un problème important, tu cherches à le comprendre, tu impliques les bonnes personnes et tu fais avancer le sujet.

Ton premier objectif sera d'absorber un maximum de contexte : le produit Solteo, nos utilisateurs et leurs métiers, le marché photovoltaïque, notre fonctionnement Produit & Tech et nos principaux enjeux business.

Tu participeras rapidement à des échanges avec nos clients et commenceras à travailler sur de vrais sujets produit.

🎯 Objectif : comprendre qui sont nos utilisateurs, comment ils utilisent Solteo, leurs principaux problèmes et les enjeux derrière notre roadmap.

data.description:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. data.title: Embedded Control Engineer
data.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.


BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will play a key part in developing the embedded control platform and will translate functional and control requirements into embedded hardware and software architectures, select appropriate microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA, or other controller technologies, and develop real-time software close to the hardware implementation. Your work will directly influence the performance, reliability, safety, and will require close collaboration with power electronics, integrated electronics, mechanical, thermal, and system engineers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Define embedded controller architectures for power electronic converters and select suitable microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA.

  • Translate power electronics and control requirements into efficient, deterministic, and robust real-time software implementations.

  • Develop, test, debug, and validate embedded software on target hardware, from individual software blocks through complete controller implementations and automated testing environments to validate the design.

  • Explore new controller technologies, embedded architectures, and software implementation concepts to improve converter performance, flexibility, reliability, functionality, and maintainability.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • You have a strong understanding of embedded architectures, and the practical considerations involved in selecting controllers for demanding real-time applications.

  • You are an expert in embedded software development for real-time applications, preferably in power electronics, industrial automation, or similar applications, spanning FPGA programming, systems programming, hardware interfaces and communication protocols.

  • You are experienced in monitoring and debugging software directly on target hardware

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with model-based development, hardware-in-the-loop testing, automated testing, or safety-critical software development is a plus.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

data.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for an experienced partnerships leader to build and scale ElevenLabs' Public Sector Partner Programme in North America — bringing together resellers, VARs, and systems integrators who help deploy our technology across federal agencies, state and local governments, and education institutions.

You'll own the public sector partner strategy end-to-end — from building relationships with leading SIs and VARs with established public sector practices, to onboarding, enabling, and activating them to sell and deliver ElevenLabs products into government and education accounts.

This is a 0→1 build: you'll design partner incentive and enablement models tailored to the procurement and compliance realities of the public sector, generate qualified pipeline through partner-led opportunities, and scale the programme against North America growth targets — while owning day-to-day execution and partner performance.

 

What success looks like (first 6–9 months)

  • Partner-Sourced & Influenced Revenue: closed-won ARR through VARs, SIs, and channel partners reaching at least 20% of North America public sector revenue

  • Partner-Sourced Pipeline: qualified pipeline created through partners, with a focus on enterprise and agency-level opportunities in federal, SLED, and education

  • Revenue-Producing Partners: number of partners actively generating pipeline, opportunities, or revenue each quarter

  • Time-to-First Revenue: speed from partner onboarding to first sourced opportunity and first closed-won deal

  • Strategic Account Penetration: new agency and institution relationships unlocked through partners that ElevenLabs would've struggled to access directly

Requirements

  • 10+ years building and scaling SaaS or Cloud solutions into public sector markets, with a deep network across federal, SLED, and education that you can leverage from day one

  • 4+ years owning VAR and SI partnerships in the public sector, with proven experience driving joint account planning, co-sell motions, and revenue — not just relationship management

  • Deep familiarity with government procurement cycles, contract vehicles (e.g. GSA schedules, BPAs), and compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, FISMA, StateRAMP)

  • A builder mindset — experience creating partner motions from 0→1, rather than inheriting a mature programme

  • Comfortable working with technical, API-driven products, and able to explain complex concepts to partners and agency stakeholders

Bonus: Mix of 3–4 years in direct public sector sales + 3–4 years in partnerships or channel; prior experience at a company scaling into gov-tech from a commercial base

data.title: Analytical Chemistry Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Switzerland.

Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.


Accountabilities
  • Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.
  • Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.
  • Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance.
  • Contribute to AI training and evaluation: Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies.
  • Support scientific quality assurance: Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs.
  • Communicate scientific reasoning clearly: Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability.

    • Requirements

  • Education: A PhD in analytical chemistry or a closely related chemical science discipline is preferred. Equivalent advanced expertise supported by relevant professional or research experience may also be valuable.
  • Technical expertise: Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry principles, instrumentation, spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical methods, quantitative analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Research or laboratory experience: Experience in laboratory-based research, analytical method validation, pharmaceutical or environmental testing, instrumentation-intensive studies, or related scientific applications is highly desirable.
  • Specialized analytical skills: Familiarity with techniques such as mass spectrometry, HPLC, GC, NMR, trace analysis, titrimetry, and laboratory QA/QC procedures.
  • Scientific evaluation skills: Ability to identify factual inaccuracies, assess scientific arguments, interpret experimental scenarios, and distinguish sound conclusions from flawed reasoning.
  • Written communication: Excellent technical writing skills and the ability to explain complex scientific concepts clearly, precisely, and logically.
  • Analytical thinking: Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and document reproducible findings.
  • AI training readiness: Interest in evaluating AI-generated content, identifying model limitations, and contributing to the development of more reliable scientific AI systems.
  • Working arrangements: Ability to work independently in a remote freelance environment, manage assignments effectively, and provide a secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection.

    • Benefits

  • Competitive hourly compensation: A pay range of $8–$65 per hour, with the final rate determined by expertise, professional experience, and geographic location. The final offer may vary from the advertised range.
  • Remote flexibility: Work remotely from India, with the flexibility associated with a freelance contract arrangement.
  • Meaningful scientific impact: Help shape AI systems that may support scientific education, research, analytical problem-solving, and laboratory workflows.
  • Intellectually stimulating work: Apply advanced analytical chemistry knowledge to challenging scientific questions and emerging AI evaluation tasks.
  • Specialized professional contribution: Use your research, instrumentation, and laboratory expertise in an innovative technology-focused environment.
  • Independent contractor arrangement: Manage your work in a freelance capacity, subject to project requirements and applicable engagement terms.

data.title: Senior Radiochemist
data.description:
ABOUT US

Transmutex is a Swiss company founded in 2019. Transmutex is currently advancing the HI-BEAM (High Intensity Breakthrough Engineering for Advanced Medicine) project, an ambitious programme to develop an industrial-scale facility for the reliable production of medical-grade Actinium-225 (Ac-225), a critical radionuclide for emerging targeted alpha therapies. 

Our team spans nuclear physics, engineering, software, radiochemistry, pharmaceutical and industrial development. Working with research labs and industrial partners worldwide, we are building the production capacity needed for the next generation of cancer treatments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the HI-BEAM project progresses from conceptual design into experimental validation, Transmutex is expanding its radiochemistry capability to translate established laboratory methods—supported by collaboration with leading international research institutes—into automated, reproducible, and commercially viable production processes.

We are seeking a Senior radiochemist to actively contribute to the technical design of Transmutex’ s radiochemistry process, in strong collaboration with renowned research labs. You will report to the Head of Extraction unit and be part of a small international team

You will primarily be based in Vernier, GE, with regular travel to Villigen, AG and to partner research labs in North America.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Process development:

  • Design and optimize radiochemical separation and purification.
  • Collaborate across teams to develop radiochemical processes and methodology.
  • Perform radiochemical and chemical analyses, including alpha and gamma spectrometry.
  • Track radiochemistry developments and adopt relevant innovations and best practices.

Industrialization and operations:

  • Develop the radiochemical process flowsheet, including unit operations, process parameters, material balances, cycle times and waste streams.
  • cale up and transfer laboratory processes to a robust and GMP-compliant production line.
  • Define process, equipment, utility, instrumentation and facility-interface requirements.
  • Support equipment selection, sizing, qualification, commissioning and process validation.
  • Develop operating procedures, batch records, control strategies and consumables requirements.
  • Prepare laboratory and production operations aligned with capacity and customer needs.
  • Train and mentor colleagues.

Compliance, quality, and safety:

  • Work with QA and Safety to ensure regulatory compliance and meet applicable standards
  • Implement and monitor safety protocols and regulatory requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS AND PROFESSIONAL ACHIEVEMENTS

The candidates we are looking for must have:

  • PhD or Master’s degree in Radiochemistry, Nuclear Chemistry or related field
  • A minimum of 10 years of experience in radiochemistry.
  • Proven experience in radiochemical separation and purification with strong knowledge of actinide chemistry.
  • In-depth understanding of radiochemistry processes, equipment and tools.
  • Mastery of characterization, alpha or gamma spectrometry, ICP-MS, ICP-OES, liquid scintillation counting, or comparable analytical techniques.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of safety, radioprotection and GMP regulations and requirements. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with ability to collaborate effectively with multiple internal and external stakeholders across disciplines. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to address complex technical challenges.
  • Proven experience in translating lab-scale processes to GMP production line would be an asset
  • Fluent in English. Excellent knowledge of French or German would be an asset

TERMS AND CONDITIONS

  • Start date:          early 2027, and no later than April 2027
  • Location:            Vernier, GE, with monthly presence at Villigen, AG; Switzerland. This position also involves regular travels to North America.
  • Contract:            Full-time, permanent employment contract
  • Package:             We offer competitive remuneration and social security, accident/disability insurance and pension plans; one day per week work from home, as well as five weeks’ paid vacation.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS:

One to two technical interviews with the hiring manager, HR and other Transmutex team members; interview with Management for shortlisted candidates. At least one interview will be organized on-site in Geneva.

data.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed

Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories — the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.

Every part we make generates data, decisions, and handoffs. Your job is to capture that knowledge, automate the work around it, and remove whatever slows production down. When a critical defense program needs parts by next week, the systems you build are why we can deliver.


The Role

As a Full-Stack Software Engineer on our manufacturing intelligence team, you'll work wherever the leverage is highest. One week that means turning an operator's spreadsheet into a proper workflow; the next it means wiring machine data into scheduling, or cutting a manual quoting step out of the order flow.


You'll own problems end to end across our customer portal, Enterprise Resource Planning / Manufacturing Execution System, and the data layer connecting them to the shop floor. 


Based at our HQ at “The Circle” (Zurich airport), your work will span:

  • Manufacturing Intelligence: Capturing process, machine, and quality data so knowledge lives in systems instead of in people's heads.

  • Automation: Replacing manual steps in quoting, planning, scheduling, and documentation with software that runs on its own.

  • Production Acceleration: Finding the bottlenecks between CAD/CAM data submission and shipped parts.

  • Tools for People: Building interfaces that make life easier for operators, engineers, and customers, whether that's a work instruction screen, a dashboard, or a self-service portal.


Importantly, you do not need prior experience in the manufacturing domain. We value a high level of curiosity and autonomy to find and solve problems.


What We're Looking For

  • Experience: 3+ years as a software engineer with proven experience in shipping code to production, across backend and frontend

  • Broad Technical Range: Experience in systems design, architecture and implementation. In general, you don’t shy away from new technologies and pick up whatever the problem requires. Our current tech stack is: Rust, PostgreSQL, React,  Python, AWS.

  • End-to-End Ownership: From talking to the user, to schema, to API, to UI, to rollout. You don't hand off "the other half."

  • Industrial Grit: Comfortable spending time on the shop floor in Germany to understand how work actually happens and how your software interacts with precision machinery.

  • Autonomy: You are comfortable with diving into new topics, coming up with solutions and driving their implementation

  • Bonus points: Knowledge of manufacturing and how factories operate, basic understanding of the Manufacturing Automation Pyramid

  • On-site: Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland.


What we're not looking for

  • Engineers who only work on frontend or only work on backend. You must be comfortable across the full stack.

  • People who need detailed specs before they start building. You'll work directly with users and define the solution yourself.

  • Developers who ship code and move on. You own the outcome — not just the PR.

  • Engineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities.


What we offer

  • Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of Europe. Your work directly enables the production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space

  • Total Ownership: High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions, and have the authority to execute.

  • The Environment: You are building solutions to accelerate production in a 5,000 m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial plastic and metal 3D printers. Your work affects production of physical parts from day one.

  • The Team: Growing team of experienced software engineers, who value an open feedback culture. You may (and are expected to) challenge the status quo, prior decisions and drive SAEKI’s way forward.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity.

  • Location: Zurich HQ with occasional travel to Factory ONE in Munich, Germany


Apply

  • Resume: Focus on systems you've built and owned.

data.title: Senior Computational Geometry Engineer
data.description:
SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed

Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.


The Role

As a Computational Geometry Engineer, you own the geometry core of our Manufacturing Intelligence stack - the engine that takes an arbitrary customer CAD model and reasons about how to build it, and then proves that we built it right.
You own the code that runs in the factory.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years building geometry-heavy software in production - CAD/CAM, geometry kernels, feature recognition, CAE/simulation preparation, metrology, or comparable.
  • B-rep and Mesh Depth. You think natively in topology and NURBS. Feature recognition, defeaturing, robust booleans, offsetting, surface/surface intersection, healing and repair. You know exactly why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations - and what to do about it. You have had the opportunity to delve into complex CAD models and are able to assess their quality in both quantitative and qualitative terms (gaps in edge, spikes in loops, tiny elements, twisted surfaces...) and ultimately predict which types of processing might be challenged.
  • Kernel Fluency. Hands-on with a geometry kernel - Parasolid, OpenCASCADE, ACIS, or equivalent - and the judgment to know which parts can be developed in-house in order to retain full control and IP rights, and which parts too complex (e.g. advanced solvers) should be integrated as 3rd parties. Comfortable with mesh and point-cloud processing (libigl, Open3D, CGAL, PCL) alongside solid modelling.You know well STEP file format and about integration into collaboration & interoperability processes.
  • Technical Excellence. Strong command of modern C++ (17+), plus Python for rapid iteration. Rust is welcome. You write and test performant code. 
  • Manufacturing Instinct. Some knowledge of fabrication techniques-casting, stamping, composites, and additive manufacturing-alongside toolsets for evaluating design manufacturability, risk profiles, quality standards, and cost factors.
  • End-to-End Ownership. Algorithm design through to a shipped, tested, maintained service.
  • First Principles Thinker. You reason by physics and mathematics, not analogy. When an algorithm fails on a real part, you know whether the bug is in the code, the model, or the assumption.
  • Industrial Grit. You want to stand next to the machine in Germany and watch your output run. The feedback loop between your code and cutting metal is the point.
  • Maniacal Urgency. Speed is our only edge. You thrive in the "chaos-to-order" phase of a startup.
  • On-site: Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland.


What we're not looking for

  • Researchers who want to publish and hand off. You ship.
  • CAD users. This is a role for people who build the tools, not drive them.
  • Engineers who need a clean spec. The problem is defined by the part, the machine, and the customer - you'll go find it.
  • People who treat "it works on the test model" as done. Real customer CAD is broken, degenerate, and adversarial. That is the job.
  • Engineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities.


What we offer

  • Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the West. Your work directly enables production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space.
  • Total Ownership: High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions - and have the authority to execute.
  • The Environment: Access to a 8,000 m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial 3D printers. Your algorithms run on real hardware from day one.
  • The Team: "Special Forces" model. Everyone senior, everyone ships. No politics, no bureaucracy. Direct feedback, high standards.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity.
  • Location: Zurich HQ, with occasional time at Factory ONE in Munich.


Apply

Resume: Focus on geometry systems you've built and owned.
GitHub/Portfolio: Show us the hard problem you solved - code, papers, or parts that came off a machine because of you.
Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first?

data.description:
Your Impact

We are looking for a senior, hands-on Dynamics 365 & Power Platform Technical Lead to own the technical development, integration, and lifecycle management of our Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform environment.
The role covers Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Customer Service, and Dynamics 365 Marketing, together with Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate, platform integrations, and related Azure services.
You will translate business requirements into robust technical solutions and determine when to use standard platform capabilities, configuration, low-code development, or custom code. The role combines hands-on platform development with technical leadership, solution governance, and long-term ownership.
This is primarily a Dynamics 365 and Power Platform role. Strong professional software development experience with C#/.NET, React, and TypeScript is a valuable asset where requirements justify custom extensions, components, services, or integrations.
You will work closely with business process owners across customer-facing teams, Technical Customer Support, Marketing, Data Engineering, and Corporate IT.
 
Your Contribution:

  • Own the platform: Set the technical direction for Dynamics 365 and Power Platform, including architecture, environments, standards, and lifecycle management.
  • Deliver solutions: Design, configure, develop, test, deploy, and maintain solutions across Dynamics 365, Dataverse, Power Apps, and Power Automate.
  • Extend where needed: Develop Dataverse plug-ins, custom APIs, business logic, client-side extensions, and Power Apps Component Framework components when standard or low-code capabilities are insufficient.
  • Integrate enterprise systems: Design and maintain secure, reliable integrations between Dynamics 365, ERP, Microsoft 365, Azure, and other business systems.
  • Ensure engineering quality: Establish appropriate practices for source control, testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, documentation, security, and technical debt management.
  • Lead technical delivery: Translate business requirements into sound solution designs, guide implementation partners, resolve complex technical issues, and ensure delivered solutions meet agreed standards.


Role Boundaries and Collaboration

The Senior Dynamics 365 & Power Platform Technical Lead is accountable for:

  • Technical architecture and solution design across Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.
  • Dataverse application models, business logic, security configuration, and extensions.
  • Platform integrations, environments, releases, and application lifecycle management.
  • Technical standards, solution quality, and coordination of technical delivery.
Business process owners are accountable for:
  • Business processes, priorities, and functional requirements.
  • Business policies and decision-making.
  • User adoption and expected business outcomes.
  • Acceptance of process and solution changes.
Data Engineering is accountable for:
  • Microsoft Fabric lakehouses and data pipelines.
  • Analytical data models and governed data products.
  • Power BI platform delivery and analytical reporting.
These roles collaborate on data contracts, data quality, lineage, security, and the reliable transfer of Dynamics 365 data into the analytical data platform.


Your Background

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions, ideally including Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service.

  • Practical experience with Power Platform ALM, Git-based source control, CI/CD, testing, and controlled deployment across environments.
  • Sound understanding of enterprise application security, reliability, maintainability, and supportability.
  • Ability to translate business workflows into pragmatic technical solutions and make sound trade-offs between standard functionality, low-code development, and custom code.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance, review solution designs and code, and work effectively with business stakeholders, technical teams, and implementation partners
  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland
Strong plus / nice-to-have
  • Professional software development experience with C#/.NET, including production applications, backend services, APIs, or integration components.
  • Experience with React and TypeScript, particularly for custom user experiences or Power Apps Component Framework components.
  • Experience designing, testing, deploying, and maintaining custom software beyond Dynamics 365 and low-code solutions.

Working style and profile
  • Combines deep Dynamics 365 and Power Platform expertise with pragmatic software engineering judgment.

data.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

 Benchling Solution Consultants (SC) are the primary solution leads with Benchling’s largest customers and prospects. Their solutions are deployed into complex enterprise IT environments, interfacing with other vendor solutions, lab instruments, and legacy applications. This is a highly visible role that partners with both external and internal teams to develop the optimal solutions that drive the most value for our customers. The SC is a pre-sales role, and as such works closely with Benchling sales leadership, account executives, professional services, and product leaders to ensure the best solutions are presented. SCs work with senior scientific and IT leaders from prospects and customers, to establish credibility and confidence from the first meeting, and to create solutions based on cutting-edge technologies.

The SC must be comfortable with Life Sciences R&D processes and scientific concepts, have experience with enterprise SaaS solutions, and be adept at working with internal and external leaders and stakeholders. You must work as a trusted adviser to translate customer objectives into detailed solutions and effectively communicate and demonstrate those solutions to prospects and customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Effectively partner with account executives, SC peers, and leadership to create account and deal strategies that lead to selection, planning out customer engagements that lead to compelling solutions.

  • Manage organized discoveries to uncover customer needs and requirements that relate to decision criteria and key business issues.

  • Craft solutions based on Benchling capabilities, industry best practices and standard R&D functions, with data models and processes that map to the customer or prospects' science and that fit into their current technology landscape.

  • Present and demonstrate the solution in a persuasive way based on key messages, decision criteria, and key business issues. Manage customer questions and objections and resolve concerns. Ensure that the solution is presented competitively, with awareness of alternatives including build in house.

  • Engage with product management to provide insight into prospect and customer needs and industry trends. Influence the roadmap for market success. Ensure that the roadmap is clear to customers as required to influence buying decisions.

  • Provide leadership by creating reusable solutions, content, and trainings for key areas. Work with the extended team to ensure that they are successful and learn from your expertise. Mentor and partner with other SCs to build their success.

     

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s in Biology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Biochemistry, Chemistry or similar Life Science field, with a minimum of 4 years of work experience, ideally customer facing.

  • Experience with scientific/informatics software such as LIMS, ELN, or others preferred. Familiarity with antibody engineering software is a plus.

  • Experience in demonstrating scientific software in a pre-sales setting to top 20 biotech and pharma companies is highly desired.

  • Demonstrated capacity to effectively model scientific data, and craft solutions, based on product knowledge and industry best practices. Prior experience in demonstrating and supporting research instruments, reagents or software desired.

  • Understand research technology generally adopted by biopharma companies.

  • Have an agile and adaptable mentality, and can quickly implement new customer engagement processes.

  • Ability to establish as a trusted advisor for scientists, and successfully pitch to scientific buyers.

  • Must be fluent in English. Fluency in German or French is a plus.

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites 25-30%.
